# STEP 27 — Validate simulator on real held-out evidence

**STEP ID:** 27

**TITLE:** Validate simulator on real held-out evidence. Proposed sub-title: "one-shot lockbox validation of SIM-AA-1 (or SIM-CHL-1) by lab-group-disjoint real series, with domain-of-validity mapping and credibility assessment".

**STATUS:** NOT STARTED; BLOCKED by 26 and 15.
- No E1/E2/E4 rows exist (tier map current_rows 0; F4).
- The `validation_scope` field of the SIM contract cannot be filled today.

**GOAL.** Decide, on real data never used for calibration, whether the simulator predicts held-out series better than credible simple baselines with calibrated intervals. Then publish:
- a per-output **domain of validation**;
- NASA-7009B-style validation and use-assessment levels;
- a `validation_status ∈ {VALIDATED_HELD_OUT, RESEARCH_ONLY}`.

This status decides Step 36 MODEL-rung exposure and Step 28 eligibility.

**SSOT ANCHORS.**
- §211.25 CV modes "held-out time, temperature, ingredient/matrix, study … Condition-OOD is especially important" (L19529–19538).
- Residual diagnostics (L19510–19527).
- Plausibility (L19578–19588).
- Parameter vs predictive uncertainty (L19590–19616).
- §213.36 focused experiment, "Headline split: condition-OOD" (L21106–21124).
- §213.37 evaluation report items (L21126–21135).
- §215.14 kinetic evaluation (L22119–22128); §215.15 family selection "not by training R² alone" (L22130–22140).
- §215.68 positive-result criterion (L22647–22657).
- G15-4 (L22385), G15-5 (L22386, candidate evidence only), G15-6 (L22387), G15-8 (L22389), G15-H (L22395), G15-R (L22394).
- §223.5 "Simulator-generated success cannot establish performance outside the simulator's validated domain" (L24119–24121).
- §214.53A: simulator-first inverse design requires a reliable forward simulator (L21869–21885).
- MP L595: "Only E1–E4 can enter evaluation sets".
- MP AB4: blind prediction vs held-out measurements (L2465–2471).

**SCIENTIFIC RATIONALE.**
- A calibrated fit is not validation. QMRF separates goodness-of-fit (Principle 4) from external predictivity (r_mechanism_registry Q3 [V]).
- Lab-medium models are biased in foods (Pin 2004 [V-meta]).
- Food kinetics are matrix-dependent (van Boekel 2008 [V]).
- The unit of independence is the lab or research group, because labs publish many papers on one system (r_simulator_vv Q3/§5.2; r_evidence_model lineage keys).
- V&V standards supply the vocabulary:
  - NASA-STD-7009B: domain of validation, M&S limits, use assessment [V];
  - ASME V&V 40 via FDA 2023: COU and model risk [V];
  - ASME V&V 20: comparison error E = S − D against validation uncertainty per point [V-meta];
  - Oberkampf & Roy: model-form uncertainty is estimated from validation comparisons and extrapolated [V-meta].
- V&V 20 itself treats interpolation and extrapolation as out of scope. So the domain of validity must be an explicit object, not an implied one.

**WHY NOW.** Step 27 is the only place where simulator credibility is earned. Every downstream use (28, 33 mechanistic arm, 34 stress tests, 36 MODEL rung, inverse design) is conditional on it (SSOT L24265 "all synthetic value is conditional on real-only validation").

**INPUT ARTIFACTS.**
- From Step 26: SIMM-AA-1 model card (CALIBRATED), PARAM (SIM-CAL), the 26a library, and the pre-registration.
- From Step 15: `registry/splits/sim_partition_v1.csv` and the read-locked SIM-VAL series in `ledgers/data/KIN.jsonl` / `KINPT.jsonl`. All are E1/E2/E4: dual-extracted, adjudicated and human-verified (G15-H L22395).
- From Step 08: lineage registry, used for automatic disjointness proofs.
- From Step 23: APPDEC decisions for the validation queries, so the prohibition logic is tested as well.
- Baseline inputs: E3 process means (USDA/Bognár, 423 vitamin C rows, F1), the Step 29/30 harness (`src/culinarystate/transition/`) for S27-B3/B4.

**REQUIRED RESEARCH.** DONE (r_simulator_vv Q3–Q5; r_eval_splits statistical protocol). OPEN: the numeric thresholds are proposals. Achievability depends on the cross-study Ea spread (U4) and on the number of validation groups. Settle by pre-registration after the census, before any validation access.

**RESEARCH FINDINGS.**
- **Framework:** NASA-7009B vocabulary + V&V 40 COU/risk + V&V 20 point comparison + Oberkampf–Roy model-form extrapolation (HIGH).
- **Statistics:** a paired cluster bootstrap over lab groups, or a cluster sign-flip permutation when there are fewer than ~20–30 clusters. Cluster-robust SEs over-reject with 5–30 clusters (Cameron 2008 via r_eval_splits [V-meta]). Do not use fold SEs (Bates 2023).
- **Coverage:** report empirical coverage per split and per cluster; there is no conformal guarantee under group shift (r_transition_ml; r_rag_confidence).
- **Domain representation:** MCP / convex hull plus kNN distance, not a box (Baranyi 1996; Le Marc 2005; Sahigara 2012; r_mechanism_registry Q2, HIGH).

**ARCHITECTURE.**
- **27a — Pre-registration** (`reports/step27/preregistration_v1.md`, hash-committed in DECISIONS before the lockbox opens). It contains:
  - primary claim, metrics, baselines, thresholds and statistical test;
  - minimum validation groups;
  - the one-shot rule.
- **27b — Validation tiers** (names chosen to avoid the V1–V5 and B-ladder collisions):
  - **HV-1 in-domain:** held-out lab groups whose matrices, T and t fall inside the calibration domain. This is the **primary, gated** tier.
  - **HV-2 held-out temperature band:** a pre-declared band, e.g. the highest calibration-adjacent band, withheld from calibration (SSOT §211.25). Reported. It provides G15-5 candidate evidence for Step 33 and is not a Step-27 pass criterion.
  - **HV-3 held-out matrix class:** used to **map** the domain of validity, not to pass. An expected degradation here is recorded, not penalised.
  - **HV-L leaching module:** only series with a water-phase assay or an open-vs-sealed contrast. It validates the leaching term separately (SSOT L8992; §210.21).
- **27c — Blind prediction run.**
  - Inputs are the SIM-VAL conditions only: initial concentration and conditions, never later timepoints.
  - The simulator outputs predictive intervals for ln(C/C0) at the reported times.
  - APPDEC gating is applied first. Queries routed SIM_PROHIBITED are counted as abstentions, and their rate is reported.
  - One execution per pre-registration. The access log is hash-chained.
- **27d — Baselines on identical queries:**
  - S27-B0: persistence (retention = 1);
  - S27-B1: E3 process-mean retention (USDA/Bognár by process type: boil / steam / stew);
  - S27-B2: empirical log-linear in t pooled over SIM-CAL;
  - S27-B3: nearest compatible evidence (same matrix class, closest condition in SIM-CAL; the Step 25 / D4 analogue);
  - S27-B4: small regularised linear / GBM on (T, t, matrix class, medium), trained on SIM-CAL.
- **27e — Negative controls:**
  - NC-1: wrong-matrix parameters (Ea, k_ref drawn from another matrix class);
  - NC-2: shuffled-temperature inputs;
  - NC-3: degradation-only model on boiling series (should lose to the full model if leaching matters);
  - NC-4: randomized-parameter simulator (parameters drawn from the literature-prior envelope, not the calibrated posterior).
  - Every control must perform worse than the calibrated simulator on HV-1. If a control matches the simulator, the simulator's apparent skill is not mechanistic.
- **27f — Metrics:**
  - per-timepoint |error| on ln retention;
  - per-series trajectory RMSE;
  - 80/90/95% interval coverage and mean width (sharpness);
  - CRPS;
  - V&V 20 comparison error E = S − D vs u_val per point (fraction with |E| ≤ 2u_val reported);
  - residual trend vs T, t and matrix;
  - cluster-bootstrap CIs.
  - Each output variable (reduced AA, water-phase AA) is assessed separately.
- **27g — Domain-of-validity artifact.** A per-output region over:
  - matrix class;
  - medium (water / steam);
  - piece-size class;
  - T range;
  - t range;
  - water:food ratio class;
  - pH and O2 (UNKNOWN-tolerant only if the validation series also had them UNKNOWN; otherwise required).
  The region is stored as validated design points + MCP + kNN radius. Calls are flagged IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN / EXTRAPOLATED_WITHIN_LIMITS / SIM_PROHIBITED. The artifact is written to VAL- records with `may_define_validated_domain=true` only for HV-1/HV-L passes.
- **27h — Credibility record:**
  - NASA-7009B validation-factor level and use-assessment level, Tables 9/15. Level semantics are as summarised in r_simulator_vv [V]; the exact rubric text is to be transcribed at Step 24 (UNVERIFIED beyond that reading).
  - V&V 40 model-risk grade per COU.
  - Credibility decision: VALIDATED_HELD_OUT for the declared domain, or RESEARCH_ONLY.
- **27i — E3 plausibility envelope.**
  - Simulator predictions at the Bognár boil/steam process categories (F1: boil 24, steam 23 rows) are compared against E3 retention ranges, on the same basis (AA vs total vitamin C; true vs apparent retention).
  - The envelope check is reported, labelled **NOT_VALIDATION**, and never used as a gate. Conditions are UNKNOWN on these rows (F1), so inputs would have to be imputed. Imputed inputs are forbidden for validation (SSOT L24249–24255 spirit; no invented values law).

**DO.**
- Pre-register, then open the lockbox once.
- Use only E1/E2/E4 human-verified held-out series.
- Prove lineage disjointness automatically.
- Report every tier, control and abstention.
- Map the domain explicitly.
- Keep negative results.
- Record per-cluster tables.

**DO NOT.**
- Do not re-fit or re-tune after seeing SIM-VAL. Any change of model or parameters after the lockbox opens makes the result exploratory, and a fresh lockbox (new groups via Step 14) is required for a confirmatory claim.
- Do not validate on USDA/Bognár K0 rows.
- Do not count HV-3 failure as a gate failure, or HV-3 success as licence to extrapolate beyond the mapped region.
- Do not use simulator outputs as labels anywhere.
- Do not pool AA and total-vitamin-C bases.
- Do not report only the best tier.

**OUTPUT ARTIFACTS.**
- `reports/step27/preregistration_v1.md` (+ hash in DECISIONS)
- `reports/step27/validation_report_v1.md` (tiers, baselines, controls, metrics, per-cluster tables, V&V 20 table)
- `ledgers/data/VAL.jsonl` rows (val_id, model+param set, evaluation KIN ids, study_disjoint proof, matrix relation, condition points, metrics, verdict, may_define_validated_domain)
- `registry/simulator_model_cards/SIMM-AA-1_v1.json`, updated with domain_of_validation, credibility levels and validation_status
- `reports/step27/domain_of_validity_v1.json`
- `reports/step27/plausibility_envelope_NOT_VALIDATION.md`
- `reports/step27/gate_result_v1.json`
- `reports/step27/access_log.jsonl`
- SVAR registry update request: reduced AA → `simulation_eligible = VALIDATED_IN_DOMAIN(SIMM-AA-1 v1)`. This needs Step 03 registry governance and human approval.

**DATA REQUIREMENTS.**
- SIM-VAL: ≥5 independent lab groups (minimum for a PASS-eligible result; r_eval_splits Step 27), held out before fitting.
- AA-specific requirement: ≥2 groups with HV-L-eligible leaching designs.
- An HV-2 band with ≥2 groups.
- Every row human-verified (G15-H).
- Recommended allocation of independent groups, frozen in Step 15: ~50% SIM-CAL / ~30% SIM-VAL / ~20% DS-TEST. With fewer than ~12 groups, DS-TEST may overlap SIM-VAL only as a declared sensitivity analysis.
- Current availability: 0 (F1, F5). Feasibility LOW–MEDIUM until the census.

**BASELINES:** S27-B0…B4 as above. The simulator must beat S27-B1 and S27-B3 on HV-1. S27-B4 is reported; beating it on HV-2 is the G15-5 hook for Step 33.

**EXPERIMENTS / ABLATIONS:**
- HV-1/HV-2/HV-3/HV-L tiers;
- NC-1…NC-4;
- leaching on/off (NC-3);
- hierarchical vs pooled parameters;
- T_p = bath vs lumped-capacitance by piece-size class (only if 26 calibrated it);
- interval method (posterior predictive vs discrepancy-inflated per Oberkampf–Roy).

**METRICS:** see 27f. The primary metric is the mean per-series |ln-retention error| on HV-1, aggregated at cluster (lab) level.

**LEAKAGE CONTROLS.**
- Lockbox frozen in Step 15 before Step 26 fitting.
- Lineage-group disjointness proof against PARAM `fitted_on`.
- Parameter re-reporting edges (Step 08).
- Validation inputs exclude post-t0 observations.
- Baselines S27-B2–B4 are trained only on SIM-CAL.
- Hash-chained access log.
- E3 plausibility rows are kept out of all metrics.
- Validation queries are excluded from any Step 25 retrieval index used to produce the prediction (L2 leakage, r_eval_splits Step 36 analogue).

**UNCERTAINTY / CONFIDENCE.**
- Empirical coverage is reported per tier and per cluster.
- Model-form uncertainty is estimated from HV-1 residuals and propagated to EXTRAPOLATED_WITHIN_LIMITS calls with widening.
- No conformal guarantee is claimed under group shift.
- Confidence:
  - design: HIGH;
  - achievability of the pass: LOW–MEDIUM (U4: given the Ea spread, honest intervals may be too wide to beat S27-B3 materially);
  - data feasibility: LOW–MEDIUM.

**COMPUTE:** CPU sufficient. Monte Carlo 10³–10⁴ draws per query and the bootstraps take minutes. A100 unnecessary.

**HUMAN REVIEW.**
- Kush + Parv co-sign the pre-registration (≈2 h each).
- The expert reviews the domain-of-validity map and the COU/risk grade (≈4–6 h).
- Parv independently audits the disjointness proof and the access log (≈2 h).
- Kush reviews the validation report (≈4 h).
- The validation series themselves were verified upstream (Step 09/11). That cost is booked there, roughly 15–30 min per series per extractor for dual extraction (UNVERIFIED estimate; r_eval_splits benchmarks).

**LICENCE / ACCESS:** same as 26. Validation series licences must allow internal research use. The DATA-SIM release (Step 28) must not redistribute closed-access digitised points.

**PASS GATE** (PROPOSED_PILOT values; frozen in 27a before opening the lockbox):
- **G27-VAL-1:** on HV-1 the simulator beats S27-B1 and S27-B3 on the primary metric.
  - Paired cluster-bootstrap 95% CI of the improvement excludes 0, or a cluster sign-flip permutation gives p < 0.05 when there are fewer than 20 lab groups.
  - Holm correction across the two comparisons.
- **G27-VAL-2:** 90% predictive-interval coverage on HV-1 in [0.80, 0.97] at cluster level. No cluster below 0.60 without an explanatory flag.
- **G27-VAL-3:** no significant monotone residual trend vs T on HV-1 (cluster permutation of Spearman ρ, p ≥ 0.05).
- **G27-VAL-4:** NC-1, NC-2 and NC-4 are worse than the simulator on HV-1 (CI excludes 0). NC-3 is worse on boiling series (AA only).
- **G27-VAL-5:** ≥5 independent validation lab groups. Otherwise the result is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and cannot PASS. This is a pre-declared eligibility rule, not a post-hoc one.
- **G27-VAL-6 (AA only):** the leaching term is validated on HV-L (coverage and bias criteria as in VAL-2/3), or the COU is restricted to steam/sealed media.
- **Also:**
  - the domain-of-validity artifact is published;
  - G15-H holds (all SIM-VAL rows human-verified);
  - G15-R holds (re-run reproduces the report hash);
  - G15-8 diagnostics (non-negativity, mass balance) hold on validation predictions.
- **HUMAN:** expert sign-off on the domain and COU.

**FAIL ACTION** (forward failure paths):
- **VAL-1 or VAL-2 fails** → `validation_status = RESEARCH_ONLY`. Consequences:
  - no Step 36 MODEL-rung exposure: the cascade skips MODEL for this system;
  - Step 28 restricted to identifiability and method-development uses (SSOT §223.4) with no pretraining claims;
  - simulator-first inverse design blocked (L21882);
  - the negative result is retained in `reports/step27/`.
- **VAL-6 fails (leaching)** → restrict the COU to steam/sealed media and re-assess only if HV-1 for that sub-domain passed in the same pre-registered analysis. Otherwise execute the pre-registered CHL switch, if it was not already used, using CHL's own frozen lockbox.
- **VAL-5 is not met (too few groups)** → NEED_DATA. Return to Step 14 with the 26a D-optimal design targets. The lockbox is not opened.
- **VAL-4 fails (a control matches the simulator)** → the simulator's skill is non-mechanistic. RESEARCH_ONLY. Investigate whether S27-B3 suffices: nearest evidence wins and is retained (SSOT §215.69 L22659–22669).
- **HV-3 shows collapse** → this is a domain-mapping result, not a failure. Narrow the domain.
- **Any post-lockbox modification** → the result becomes exploratory, and confirmatory re-validation needs fresh groups.

**FALLBACK:**
1. COU narrowed to the validated sub-domain.
2. SIM-CHL-1 (if not yet used).
3. Retain nearest-evidence / tabular as the MODEL rung for this target, in Step 36 via Steps 30/33.
4. QUALITATIVE direction labels only (L15-A).

**PARALLEL WORK:** Step 27 can run in parallel with Steps 30–31 (independent data planes). Step 28 tooling (generator code, controls) can be written in parallel but not executed for priors. Step 32 K-ablation can begin on SIM-CAL data.

**NEXT IF PASS:**
- Step 28 unlocks (controlled E7 generation from this sim_version only).
- Step 33 receives the mechanistic arm and HV-2 evidence.
- Step 34 may use in-domain simulator trajectories for stress tests.

# STEP 28 — Generate controlled E7 synthetic prior

**STEP ID:** 28

**TITLE:** Generate controlled E7 synthetic prior. Proposed rename for namespace clarity: "Generate controlled TIER-E7 (SIMULATED) synthetic prior". "E7" collides with the SSOT L12 encoder rung E7 (SSOT L8497), L13E Phase E7 (SSOT L45417) and MP E0–E14 (mp_part1 §gaps #2).

**STATUS:** NOT STARTED; DEFERRED-BY-GATE.
- Requires Step 27 PASS for any prior generation.
- E7 current_rows 0 (F4).
- SX-13-05 MISSING (F5).
- Contract only: `simulated_state_changes_schema_v1.csv`, `may_enter_gold_evaluation=false`.

**GOAL.**
- Generate a provenance-complete, domain-randomised synthetic dataset (DATA-SIM v1) from a *validated* sim_version, for **specified uses only**:
  - identifiability / optimal-design studies;
  - rollout stress tests;
  - method-development benchmarks (e.g. SINDy/CRNN recovery);
  - pretraining for Step 30/33 ablations.
- Specify the controls that any Step 30/33 use must run, so that G15-10 (L22391) can be decided honestly.
- No E7 row ever enters a test, calibration, Gold or evidence set.

**SSOT ANCHORS.**
- §223 in full (L24064–24268):
  - S-MECH generation list (L24091–24097);
  - domain randomisation (L24099–24107);
  - allowed uses (L24109–24117);
  - forbidden claim (L24119–24121);
  - statistical generators LOW priority (L24173–24186);
  - ratio sweep 0/0.25/0.5/1/2/5× (L24188–24203);
  - TRTR/TSTR/mixed (L24205–24213);
  - memorisation/two-sample checks (L24215–24223);
  - fidelity ordering (L24225–24245);
  - **hard prohibition, frozen** (L24247–24255);
  - collapse/sim-gap risks (L24257–24265).
- §201.13 multi-fidelity, "Synthetic rows must retain a source/fidelity flag and must not be silently pooled" (L16763–16772).
- §212.46 synthetic rollout benchmark, kept separate (L20441–20445).
- §213.43A SINDy/CRNN "belongs to simulator recovery studies" (via ssot_l15b §2.2).
- §215.38 G15-10 (L22391).
- §226.6 M4 hybrid + synthetic-prior ablation (L24549–24558).
- §227.5 C4 (L24700ff).
- §227.11 synthetic promotion rule (via ssot_sparsity §4.2, L24800–24822).
- §225.7 PFN analogy, "custom kinetic-PFN as a stretch" (L24450–24456).
- §274.2 randomized-simulator control (L44358–44360; L13E, analogue).
- §274.5 "Use simulators first for validation/stress testing; treat pretraining as a gated experiment" (L44385–44394).
- MP L594–595: E7 "priors or stress tests only".

**SCIENTIFIC RATIONALE.**
- Simulator pretraining has helped only when the pretraining data spanned more variability than the real training data (Read et al. 2019 PGDL [V-meta]). This supports domain randomisation and gives a testable precondition.
- PFN/TabPFN priors are generic function-family priors (Müller et al. 2022 [V]; Hollmann et al. 2025 [V]). They are not evidence that S-MECH pretraining helps, so SSOT §225.7 is an analogy.
- Model collapse (Shumailov et al. 2024 [V]) justifies keeping statistical/LLM generators LOW. For S-MECH, the analogous risk is that simulator assumptions replace real tails.
- TSTR (Esteban et al. 2017 [V]) is the right evaluation frame.
- Gaps in SSOT §223 for L15 (r_simulator_vv Q6), added here:
  - a matched-volume randomized / wrong-physics simulator control;
  - a real-n learning curve;
  - a calibration-leakage control;
  - full per-row provenance;
  - generation only from a Step-27-passed version.

**WHY NOW.**
- Step 28 must follow 27, because §223.2 requires a validated model.
- It must precede 30/33, which consume it only as an ablation, and 34, which uses stress trajectories.
- Its most valuable *early* use (identifiability and design) already exists in 26a/26c without E7 rows. So the step is low-urgency, and DEFER is the default until 27 passes.

**INPUT ARTIFACTS.**
- SIMM-AA-1 (VALIDATED_HELD_OUT) with domain_of_validation and M&S limits (Step 27).
- PARAM posterior (SIM-CAL only).
- Step 15 partitions (SIM-CAL ⊆ DS-TRAIN; DS-TEST and SIM-VAL identities).
- Real observation-process statistics from SIM-CAL: design grids, noise, LOD/censoring rates and sparsity patterns.
- `simulated_state_changes_schema_v1.csv` plus the Step 04.x extensions.

**REQUIRED RESEARCH.** DONE (r_simulator_vv Q6; ssot_sparsity §4.2). Remaining unknown U5, whether E7 adds anything beyond a hierarchical Bayesian kinetic fit, is empirical. It is probably small, which is why the step is deferred and gated.

**RESEARCH FINDINGS:** see SCIENTIFIC RATIONALE. MEDIUM–HIGH that the tiers are sound; LOW that pretraining will help at this data scale.

**ARCHITECTURE.**
- **28a — Generator** (`src/culinarystate/simulation/prior_generator.py`). It samples:
  - parameters from the SIM-CAL posterior, plus a *declared* widening factor for domain randomisation;
  - conditions over (i) the validated domain, and (ii) an EXTRAPOLATED_WITHIN_LIMITS band whose rows are flagged;
  - schedule shapes;
  - study offsets;
  - measurement noise and LOD censoring;
  - sparse observation grids that mimic SIM-CAL reporting (SSOT L24091–24097).
  It never samples outside the M&S limits, unless a row is generated for a RANDOMIZED_BEYOND_LIMITS control and labelled as such.
- **28b — Per-row provenance** (all mandatory):
  - `provenance_class = SIMULATED`, `evidence_tier = E7` (namespace TIER-E7);
  - `sim_model_id`, `sim_version` (code hash), `param_draw_id`/seed, `randomisation_spec_id`;
  - `domain_flag ∈ {IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN, EXTRAPOLATED_WITHIN_LIMITS, RANDOMIZED_BEYOND_LIMITS}`;
  - `validation_status` (copied from the model card);
  - `simulator_family = FOOD_PROCESS_KINETIC`, `clock = PROCESS_TIME`;
  - `generated_for ∈ {IDENTIFIABILITY, DESIGN, STRESS_TEST, METHOD_BENCHMARK, PRETRAIN_ABLATION}`;
  - `may_enter_gold_evaluation = false`, `may_enter_calibration = false`, `may_enter_evidence = false`.
- **28c — Storage.** A separate simulation-memory plane: `ledgers/sim/DATA-SIM_v1/*.parquet` plus `reports/step28/data_sim_card_v1.md`. Never in `ledgers/data/EVD.jsonl` or DATA-EVIDENCE. A firewall test fails the build if any SIM id appears in an EVD, split-test or calibration manifest.
- **28d — Uses, in order of priority:**
  1. identifiability and optimal-design studies to steer Step 14 acquisition (§224.4);
  2. Step 34 rollout stress tests (trust-horizon method development, kept separate from real evaluation, L20441–20445);
  3. method benchmarks (e.g. SINDy/CRNN topology recovery, which belongs here per §213.43A; RESEARCH_ONLY);
  4. **pretraining as a gated ablation** executed inside Step 30/33, never as a default.
- **28e — Mandatory controls for any PRETRAIN_ABLATION** (specified here, executed in 30/33):
  - **C-1** synthetic ratio sweep 0/0.25/0.5/1/2/5× relative to real, reporting all ratios (L24188–24203);
  - **C-2** real-n learning curve (25/50/75/100% of real training groups) with and without E7;
  - **C-3** TRTR / TSTR / mixed (L24205–24213);
  - **C-4 matched-volume randomized / wrong-physics simulator control**: same architecture and row count, generated from the NC-1/NC-4 simulators of Step 27 (analogue of §274.2);
  - **C-5 calibration-leakage audit**: SIM-CAL groups ⊆ downstream training groups; DS-TEST ∩ SIM-CAL = ∅; DS-TEST ∩ SIM-VAL = ∅ by default (overlap only as a declared sensitivity);
  - **C-6** memorisation / two-sample / physics checks (L24215–24223);
  - **C-7** variability-span check: the E7 condition span ⊇ the real training span, from Read et al. 2019;
  - **C-8** calibration damage: real-only study-disjoint coverage and width, with vs without E7.
  - The headline is always real and study-disjoint (L24209–24213).

**DO.**
- Generate only from a VALIDATED_HELD_OUT sim_version.
- Label every row.
- Store in the SIM plane.
- Run all controls whenever E7 is used for training.
- Retain negative results.
- Version DATA-SIM with a dataset card that states simulator assumptions (§224.11 "do not claim acquisition efficiency from simulations only without stating the simulator assumption").

**DO NOT.**
- Do not use E7 in test, calibration, Gold, EVD, RAG DIRECT/INTERPOLATE evidence or Step 36 citations (SSOT L24247–24255, frozen).
- Do not hand-pick the best ratio.
- Do not generate from a RESEARCH_ONLY simulator for pretraining claims.
- Do not use statistical or LLM generators for targets (L24184–24186).
- Do not mix with L13E cultural simulations.
- Do not build a custom kinetic-PFN (stretch only, L24456).
- Do not use GPU or A100.

**OUTPUT ARTIFACTS.**
- `src/culinarystate/simulation/prior_generator.py` and `tests/unit/test_prior_generator_*.py` (provenance completeness, firewall)
- `ledgers/sim/DATA-SIM_v1/` (partitioned parquet, hashed)
- `reports/step28/data_sim_card_v1.md` (assumptions, domain, randomisation spec, intended uses, prohibited uses)
- `reports/step28/identifiability_design_v1.md` (design targets fed to Step 14)
- `reports/step28/controls_spec_v1.md` (C-1…C-8, consumed by 30/33)
- `reports/step28/gate_result_v1.json`

**DATA REQUIREMENTS:** a validated simulator plus SIM-CAL observation-process statistics. No new external data. Size: small (10³–10⁵ synthetic series is ample for these uses; stated as an estimate).

**BASELINES:** for the pretraining ablation in 30/33, the real-only model (0× ratio, TRTR) is the mandatory baseline. Others: the randomized-simulator control (C-4) and hierarchical Bayesian kinetics without E7.

**EXPERIMENTS / ABLATIONS:** C-1…C-8. For identifiability: D-optimal design ranking of candidate temperatures and times for Step 14. For stress tests: rollout drift on synthetic multi-stage schedules.

**METRICS.**
- Provenance completeness: 100% of required fields.
- Firewall violations: must be 0.
- Two-sample distance and nearest-real-row distance.
- Physics-violation rate: must be 0.
- For ablations: real-only study-disjoint error, coverage and width per ratio; learning-curve area; difference vs randomized control (paired cluster bootstrap).

**LEAKAGE CONTROLS:**
- C-5 partition algebra, checked automatically against the Step 15 manifest and Step 08 lineage.
- E7 rows carry sim ids that are blocked in test and calibration manifests.
- The generator never reads SIM-VAL or DS-TEST.
- Conditions sampled near DS-TEST conditions are allowed (they are synthetic), but parameters come from SIM-CAL only.

**UNCERTAINTY / CONFIDENCE.**
- E7 rows inherit parameter-posterior draws. No E7 row carries a "confidence"; it carries its domain_flag.
- Confidence: design MEDIUM–HIGH; probability that pretraining passes G15-10, LOW (U5).

**COMPUTE:** CPU sufficient. Generation is trivial. The pretraining ablations are run in Steps 30/33 (CPU tabular or small models; GPU helpful only if Step 33 trains a neural arm, which is unlikely to be justified). A100 unnecessary.

**HUMAN REVIEW:**
- Kush reviews the DATA-SIM card and the controls spec (≈3 h).
- Parv audits the firewall tests and the C-5 partition proof (≈2 h).
- Expert review is not required unless the randomisation widening factor is disputed (≈0–2 h).

**LICENCE / ACCESS.**
- DATA-SIM contains no source data: only simulated values plus parameter ids.
- Release of PARAM values derived from closed-access figures needs the Step 06 derived-data policy.
- Internal use only until that policy is decided.

**PASS GATE** (for Step 28 itself; G15-10 is decided in 30/33):
- **G28-GEN:**
  - generated from a VALIDATED_HELD_OUT sim_version;
  - 100% provenance-field completeness;
  - 0 firewall violations (CI test);
  - 0 physics-constraint violations;
  - C-7 span check satisfied;
  - two-sample / memorisation report produced;
  - the DATA-SIM card is human-approved.
- **G15-10 hook:** the controls spec is frozen before any Step 30/33 ablation runs. "Unacceptable calibration damage" is pre-registered as PROPOSED_PILOT: real-only 90% coverage drop > 0.03 absolute, or interval-width increase > 20%, on any headline study-disjoint split.
- **HR-SYN-1** (L24251) holds by construction.

**FAIL ACTION:**
- **Step 27 not passed** → Step 28 is limited to IDENTIFIABILITY / DESIGN / METHOD_BENCHMARK uses with `validation_status = NOT_VALIDATED/RESEARCH_ONLY` labels. No PRETRAIN_ABLATION and no G15-10 claim. G15-10 is recorded as "not attempted" with the reason.
- **Firewall or provenance test fails** → block the release and fix.
- **Two-sample check shows copying or implausible rows** → fix the generator; do not release.
- **In 30/33 the E7 ablation fails G15-10** (no real-only gain, gain not above C-4, or calibration damage) → retain the real-only model, record the negative result (§215.69), and close the pretraining line for this system. Do not retry other ratios after the fact.

**FALLBACK:** no synthetic prior. Hierarchical Bayesian kinetic priors from 26d serve the "prior" role directly (§226.2 L24485–24517: "mechanistic simulator + Bayesian parameter prior + real fitting").

**PARALLEL WORK:** generator code and the controls spec can be written in parallel with Step 27 but not executed for priors. Uses 1–3 can run in parallel with Phase G.

**NEXT IF PASS:** Step 30/33 E7 ablation arms (G15-10); Step 34 stress-test lane; Step 14 design-target refresh.

**STOP FOR REVIEW:** after the DATA-SIM card and controls spec, before any Step 30/33 training run touches E7.

Any later change is logged in DECISIONS and labels the affected results exploratory (no post-hoc gate weakening).

  - paired cluster bootstrap of differences over the unit of independence;
  - cluster sign-flip permutation when there are fewer than about 20–30 clusters;

  - nested grouped tuning;

  - margin-δ promotion.

- **PG-5. Prior-exposure honesty.** DEL-2 already inspected outcomes on all 17,978 E3 rows. Any Phase-G result on those rows is a **pre-registered re-analysis with known prior exposure**, never a fresh confirmatory test. Fresh confirmatory status exists only for rows first sealed at Step 15 that no model has seen.
- **PG-6. Model ambition ≤ evidence rung** (SSOT L18050). The K-rung (K0–K4) and data regime (D-A…D-D) of each row decide which rungs are eligible ("dataset supervision ⇒ eligible model family", SSOT §215.4, L22017–22025).
- **PG-7. Stop rule.** §215.70 (SSOT L22671–22683) is binding on every step. Its "cold-pair collapses / retrieval matches advanced models" condition is **already triggered** for USDA and PE by DEL-2. The correct response is acquisition, not depth.

## STEP 29 — TRANSITION_BOOTSTRAP_V0

**STEP ID:** 29

**TITLE:** TRANSITION_BOOTSTRAP_V0. This is a pre-registered deterministic-first endpoint transition benchmark on frozen evidence.

**STATUS:**
- CONTRACT DRAFTED, NOT RUN (`reports/h_state/transition_bootstrap_v0_contract.md`, header "defined, NOT run").
- A precursor exists: DEL-2 EXP-000001..4 DONE (D0–D5, D7; D6 skipped).
- Engineering is PARTIAL. `transition/{baselines,splits,evaluate,dataset,cross_source}.py` exists. A known `test_transition` hang is deselected. No pandas environment exists on this server.

**GOAL:** Establish the honest credibility floor for endpoint retention (T1) and yield (T2) transitions:
- run D0–D4 (deterministic), then D5;
- under leakage-safe, lineage-aware split families;
- with censor-aware metrics, group-disjoint calibration, shortcut controls and a label-noise ceiling;
- and write the first §216.13 decision record. The record answers items 1–2 ("supportable targets", "strongest simple baseline"), SSOT L23034–23049.

**SSOT ANCHORS:**
- §208.4 data-to-claim ladder (L18033–18056); rule 15 "may stop at retrieval/tabular/kinetic" (L18031);
- §209.17 D0–D11 (L18543–18613); persistence mandatory (L18292–18296);
- §215.2 regimes D-A…D-D (L21949–21997); §215.4 activation rule (L22017–22025); §215.24 null-transition test (L22236);
- §215.26–27 pre-model data audit and support map (L22251–22285);
- §216.1 transition-event table (L22733–22798); §216.6 version registry (L22885–22896); §216.13 decision record (L23034–23049);
- G15-1, G15-2 (partial), G15-3, G15-R (L22380–22396);
- §201.5–201.9 retention definitions, dead band and censoring (L16614–16717); §202.1–202.4 headline splits and shortcuts (L16845–16919);
- §221.18 completion protocol items 1–6 (L23911–23919);
- §227.11 sparse-method promotion (L24800–24822).

**SCIENTIFIC RATIONALE:**
- RQ15-1 (SSOT L18207) asks whether explicit transition modelling beats persistence, process-average, nearest-evidence and tabular baselines under cold splits.
- Current evidence is K0/D-A aggregate endpoints with no conditions (SSOT L15657, L19782–19792). The only defensible claims are method/food-level endpoint effects.
- The scientific question is therefore not "which model", but "is there any transferable process signal beyond persistence and lookup once leakage is controlled?"
- DEL-2 says "barely, and only on random/pair splits". V0 makes this answer reproducible, pre-registered and lineage-correct.

**WHY NOW:**
- Step 29 depends on frozen evidence (05, 08, 15), not on Phases D–F. The SSOT lists retention/process transition baselines as "what can run now" (§216.9, ssot_l15b §6).
- Placing it after Steps 26–28 is a sequencing artefact. It should run as soon as Step 08 lineage and a Step-15 E3-stratum freeze exist, in parallel with Phases C–F.
- Its output is the transition fallback that Step 36 C9 needs (impl notes: C9 "not wired"), and the VoI signal Step 14 needs.

**INPUT ARTIFACTS:**
- ES-1.1 EVD export, regenerable (`reports/es1/es1_1_audit.md`), superseded by **EVD export v2** from Step 08. v2 adds `lineage_root_id`, `split_group_id`, `independence_resolution`, `derivation_status`, `donor_row_ids` (r_evidence_model).
- Step-15 frozen snapshot: `DATA-EVIDENCE v1` (or the early stratum freeze `DATA-EVIDENCE v1-E3`; see Lookahead) with its sha256.
- SPLIT manifests (`ledgers/data/SPLIT.jsonl`, not yet created).
- COND (Step 07 normaliser, fingerprint e7d58913) and SVAR duplicate mapping.
- `registry/censoring_registry_v1.csv`, `registry/value_origin_registry_v1.csv`, `registry/retention_type_registry_v1.csv`.
- TB contract; DEL-2 code; `registry/phase_g_preregistration_v1.csv` (new, PG-2).

**REQUIRED RESEARCH:**
- (a) Is TabPFN v2 eligible (CPU, licence)? **DONE.**
- (b) Statistical protocol for few clusters. **DONE**, r_eval_splits.
- (c) Group-shift conformal. **DONE**, r_transition_ml Q6.
- (d) USDA "values >100 reported as 100" cap semantics. Partly done: r_evidence_model reports the USDA note text; the source PDF itself is UNVERIFIED.
- (e) Is USDA %TR vs %AR identifiable per row? OPEN; only answerable by reading the R6 documentation inside Step 08/12.

**RESEARCH FINDINGS:**
- Public tabular benchmarks are IID only. TabArena explicitly excludes grouped and shift data (Erickson et al. 2025, arXiv 2506.16791). So the effective sample size (≈100–300 independent cells per source) and the shift decide model choice, not row count (r_transition_ml Q1).
- Calibration on random partitions under-covers on cold splits: DEL-2 reached 0.72–0.87 at nominal 0.90 (WORKLOG S017). The fix is group-disjoint calibration (Dunn et al. 2023; Barber et al. 2023, Ann. Statist.).
- Few-cluster inference over-rejects (Cameron, Gelbach & Miller 2008). Fold-SE intervals under-cover (Bates, Hastie & Tibshirani 2023).
- The ML-beats-retention-factors literature has no food-held-out split (Naravane & Tagkopoulos 2023, CRFS 6:100500). It is not cold-split evidence.
- **New inference from this drafter (checked against the DEL-2 table):** under USDA matrix_disjoint, D0 persistence has median AE = 0.0. Combined with 2,620/6,994 USDA rows censored GT_CAP (≥0.975), censor-aware MAE gives persistence a near-free score on about 37% of rows. Persistence's "cold win" may therefore be partly a cap artefact. Censored and uncensored strata must be reported separately (UNVERIFIED magnitude; needs the stratified rerun).

**ARCHITECTURE:**
- **29.0 Pre-model audit (no outcomes).** §215.26 counts and the §215.27 support map per target. Report to `reports/step29/v0_data_audit.md`. Include the frozen cell definition (MP DEL-2 L3103–3110), the density under that definition, n_independent_groups per target/process family, and the giant-component share.
- **29.1 Ladder crosswalk.** `registry/transition_ladder_crosswalk_v1.csv` with B-0=D0, B-1=D1, B-2=D3 (matrix arm), B-3=D2, B-4=D4, B-5=D5. Also maps M0=D0, M1≈D2/D4, M2≈D5, M9≈D9, M10≈D10/D11. MP AZ6 retired (plan change request).
- **29.2 Pre-registration amendment** (`reports/step29/v0_preregistration_amendment.md`, frozen before any run):
  - **(i) Primary criterion.** Keep TB §6 unchanged: paired LB > 0 vs B-0 on S-3 or S-4, per target, with a shortcut re-run.
  - **(ii) Secondary headline.** Pair-holdout (SSOT §202.3) is reported as the secondary headline with Park–Marcotte C-class strata, labelled "compositional, non-cold". **Making pair-holdout the primary success criterion now would be post-hoc weakening**, because DEL-2 already showed D5 wins on pair-holdout for USDA and Bognár.
  - **(iii) S-6** = PE-only lineage-component split.
  - **(iv) S-7** = DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.
  - **(v)** Add a both-new (S4-type) abstention stratum.
  - **(vi)** K_min clusters per headline split (PROPOSED_PILOT K = 10). Below K the split is reported as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.
  - **(vii)** Censored/uncensored stratified reporting.
- **29.3 Engineering preconditions** (not science):
  - fix or explain the `test_transition` hang;
  - get a human-authorised Python environment with pandas/pyarrow/sklearn;

  - **label-noise ceiling**: same-cell cross-source disagreement. USDA↔Bognár MAE 0.075–0.083 on 67 cells (`reports/del2/cross_source_v1.md`); FDC↔R6 0.167, which is circular (r_transition_ml). Reported as an irreducible-error reference.

**DO:**

**SSOT ANCHORS:**
- §209.6 tabular credibility floor (L18338–18361); §209.17 D3–D7 (L18565–18595);
- §219 tensor/mask/regimes (L23340–23525); §220 CF analogy, propensity, DR, "propensity weighting does not license random splits" (L23535–23688); §220.4 "D3 … benchmarked before advanced completion" (L23606);
- §221 D7 sub-ladder, "well-tuned biased MF/FM/Bayesian completion are mandatory before neural CF" (L23714–23894);
- §221.17–221.19 conformalized completion and completed-cell class (L23902–23937); §222.1–222.10 censoring/imputation/anti-inflation (L23947–24060);
- §226.4 M2 "Pass target: G15-9 or reject the completion hypothesis" (L24528–24539); §227.11 (L24800–24822);
- G15-2/6/7/9 (L22383–22390); §202.12 seeds/bootstrap (L17028–17036); §202.16 "simpler tree winning is valid" (L17091–17103).

**SCIENTIFIC RATIONALE:**
- The PART XI thesis is that which cells were measured is structured information (SSOT L23340), and that low-rank side-information completion may transfer to cold foods, processes or compounds.
- This is testable only against an honest hierarchical model. SSOT §220.4 states that the mixed model (food + process + compound + study effects) "serves the same broad purpose as factorization".
- The repo D3 pools only target×process→process→global. **It under-implements SSOT D3**, which partially pools "across food class, process family, compound/target class, study/source" (L18565–18572). So the real D3 has never been run.
- In a food meta-analysis, study random effects dominated (Karamcheti et al. 2025, Food Microbiol 128:104731; r_transition_ml Q3).

**WHY NOW:**
- It follows Step 29 on the same manifests and is not dependent on Phases D–F.
- The decision it produces (accept/reject completion) determines whether Steps 14/36 use completion posteriors for VoI and MODEL estimates.
- Running it early prevents building D7 variants that cannot pass (ssot_sparsity risk 16).

**INPUT ARTIFACTS:**
- Step 29 outputs (manifests, crosswalk, decision record, preregistration rows).
- `DATA-EVIDENCE v1` §229.3 artifact: observed tensor + observation mask + evidence ledger + cold-start split registry (Step 15 look-ahead).
- Side information:
  - FDC raw-food proximate vector (Step 12, linked via ingredient_id);
  - food group / FoodOn class (ING);
  - process family, medium and water contact (PROC/COND);
  - target class (SVAR).
- Propensity covariates: year, platform, source type (Step 08/13). Until those exist, marginal-frequency proxies only.
- Step 13 discovery-corpus metadata for unextracted papers (propensity universe).

**REQUIRED RESEARCH:**
- (a) TabPFN eligibility. DONE.
- (b) Conformal under group shift. DONE.
- (c) Censored objectives for GBDT and mixed models (Tobit / interval / AFT). PARTIAL. XGBoost `survival:aft` is an interval-censored option per ssot_sparsity R3, UNVERIFIED this run. A censored Gaussian mixed model on the logit/log scale is standard (from knowledge, UNVERIFIED).
- (d) FM/SMURFF licences. OPEN (ssot_sparsity R5). Not blocking, because a numpy FM/soft-impute implementation is small.

**RESEARCH FINDINGS:**
- Trees remain state of the art at ~10k IID rows. Light tuning matters more than the family choice (Grinsztajn et al. 2022; McElfresh et al. 2023). CatBoost is the best single tuned model in TabArena (2025), which is IID-only.
- TabPFN v2 (Hollmann et al., Nature 637:319, 2025):
  - evaluated on random splits only;
  - scope ≤10k samples;
  - the v2 weights licence is Apache-2.0 + attribution (HF card, checked);
  - the TabPFN-2.5 weights are non-commercial;
  - TabPFN-3.5's grouped-split claim is a vendor preprint (UNVERIFIED).
- FMs and Macau use side features for cold cells (Rendle 2010; Simm et al. 2015). Pure-ID MF predicts cold rows only through biases.
- Propensity-debiased evaluation (Schnabel et al. 2016) is a sensitivity analysis only (SSOT §220.10).
- Group-level subsampling conformal (Dunn et al. 2023) targets new-group coverage.

**ARCHITECTURE** (rungs fixed before any run; one row per rung in the crosswalk):
- **D3-full.** Crossed random-effects GLMM on the logit/log retention scale:
  - matrix ⊂ food group; process ⊂ family; target ⊂ class; source/study intercepts;
  - selected interactions: food group × process family, target class × process family;
  - censored (interval) likelihood for GT_CAP rows;
  - REML or a weakly-informative Bayesian prior with a sensitivity check (SSOT L19445–19458).
  - Predicts group means for cold matrices and exposes the study variance component.
  - This is the control D7 must beat (**SCR-G-6**: add D3 to the G15-9 comparison set).
- **D3-legacy.** The existing nested shrinkage, for continuity.
- **D3-R.** Ridge / elastic-net on one-hot + side features (SSOT §209.6 lists ridge; the code lacks it).
- **D4.** Hierarchical-fallback lookup (unchanged).
- **D5-tuned.** CatBoost or LightGBM with a small fixed budget, tuned in inner grouped folds (nested). D5-HistGB is retained for continuity.
- **D6.** TabPFN v2 on CPU.
  - The context set contains training groups only.
  - Licence row recorded.
  - Comparator only; no headline or production dependence.
  - If >10k rows, use per-source contexts (all sources are ≤7k).
- **D7 sub-ladder:**
  - D7a: biased MF, after the D7≡D1 fix.
  - D7d: FM with side features.
  - D7e: soft-impute where the matrix view is well defined (SSOT L23781: "Do not let Bayesian/neural complexity skip it").
  - D7b: BPMF "if practical".
  - Optional DropoutNet-style row/column masking ablation (SSOT L23853).
  - Neural CF is banned (SSOT L23892).
- **Censoring arms.** (i) legacy bound-0.975; (ii) interval/Tobit likelihood (D3-full natively; D5 via an AFT or interval objective if available, otherwise a two-part model); (iii) drop-censored as a sensitivity arm. §222.2 forbidden defaults are never used.
- **Propensity.**
  - Covariate model e(x) (food popularity, target class, process, year, platform, source type) once Step 08/13 metadata exist.
  - Clipped IPS, naive vs weighted, DR as a `[HYPOTHESIS]` arm.
  - Positivity/overlap report (MP AM4).
  - Until then: marginal-frequency propensity, labelled "proxy".
- **Uncertainty.** Split-conformal / CV+ and CQR, calibrated group-disjoint in the same family as each test split (PG-4); per-split and worst-cluster coverage; risk–coverage curves (precursor to G15-7).
- **Per-source models first.** Pooling is tested explicitly:
  - USDA+Bognár pooled on shared nutrients as a source-transfer diagnostic;
  - PE joined only through target-class random effects;
  - Bognár process-disjoint is never a headline (degenerate).

**DO:**
- Run §221.18 items 1–9. "Masked-real-cell" must use **structured** masking (whole cells within observed pairs, grouped by lineage), not MCAR row masking (ssot_sparsity §9 #13).
- Run §222.10 items 1–7.
- Use frequency/support buckets (SSOT §220.9).
- Use ≥5 seeds for D5/D6/D7.
- Write a formal G15-9 decision record.
- Use identical folds across all rungs.

**DO NOT:**
- Promote any rung on random or pair splits alone (SSOT §215.68).
- Impute test targets.
- Put completed cells into evidence or citations (SSOT L23937).
- Tune on test.
- Treat IPW-weighted MAE as a headline.
- Use isotonic calibration below ~1,000 labels (r_rag_confidence).
- Build neural CF, deep tabular or GP headline arms.

**OUTPUT ARTIFACTS:**
- `experiments/EXP-0000NN/` per rung family.
- `reports/step30/bakeoff_results.md`.
- `reports/step30/g15_2_completion_audit.md` (D0–D6 table on all eligible headline splits).
- `reports/step30/g15_9_decision_record.md`, ACCEPTED or REJECTED with reasons.
- `reports/step30/anti_inflation_report.md` (§222.10).
- `reports/step30/propensity_positivity_report.md`.
- `reports/step30/conformal_by_split.md`.
- Model cards `ledgers/data/MODEL.jsonl` entries (MP X6 MODEL- prefix = ML models).
- §216.13 decision-record items 3 (partial) and 5 (no neural).
- Updated provisional C9 estimator spec for Step 36: `reports/step30/c9_transition_fallback_spec.md`.

**DATA REQUIREMENTS:**
- As Step 29, plus side-information joins:
  - FDC proximates for ≥80% of linked matrices (PROPOSED target; UNVERIFIED feasibility);
  - food-group mapping for 100% of linked matrices.
- For any cold-compound claim, compound descriptors (MOL ledger; RDKit pending, approval needed).
- Study-disjoint claims are PE-only until Steps 10–14 add identifiable studies.

**BASELINES:** D0–D4 from Step 29 (frozen numbers re-used, not re-tuned). Shortcut controls as in Step 29.

**EXPERIMENTS / ABLATIONS:**
- E30-1: D3-full vs D3-legacy vs D4 on cold splits (does real hierarchical pooling help cold?).
- E30-2: D5-tuned vs D5-HistGB.
- E30-3: D6 vs D5 vs D3-full.
- E30-4: D7a/d/e vs D3-full/D5/D6 (G15-9).
- E30-5: censoring arms.
- E30-6: with/without missingness mask; with/without propensity weighting.
- E30-7: support-bucket analysis.
- E30-8: DropoutNet-style cold masking (optional).
- E30-9: source pooling diagnostic.

**METRICS:**
- As Step 29, plus macro-MAE across targets/processes (SSOT §215.6);
- per-bucket MAE; IPW-MAE (sensitivity);
- interval coverage/width/CRPS; risk–coverage AURC;
- runtime and RAM per model (SSOT L17063–17072).

**LEAKAGE CONTROLS:**
- All Step-29 controls.
- Side features from FDC must not encode the target. FDC cooked values imputed from R6 are **circular** (`reports/del2/fdc_pairs_v1.md`), so only raw-food analytical composition is allowed.
- The TabPFN context is restricted to training groups.
- Inner-fold tuning only.
- Propensity and imputer are fitted per training fold.
- The completion model never sees test cells' neighbours from the same lineage component.

**UNCERTAINTY / CONFIDENCE:**
- MEDIUM. The literature cannot say whether D3-full, FM side features or D6 help on these cold splits (r_transition_ml Q10). Only the pilot can.
- HIGH that G15-9 is likely REJECTED on current D-A data. That is an acceptable, publishable outcome (§215.69).

**COMPUTE:**
- CPU sufficient. GLMM/BPMF via PyMC/NumPyro on CPU takes minutes to hours.
- TabPFN v2 on CPU: 16 GB+ RAM, ≤7k rows per source; feasible on the 128-core / 251 GB server or the Mac.
- GPU helpful only for TabPFN speed (not needed offline). A100 unnecessary.

**HUMAN REVIEW:**
- Kush approves the G15-9 decision record and any Step-36 C9 change.
- No annotation.
- An expert reviews D3-full grouping hierarchies (food group, process family) for scientific sense (≈2 h).

**LICENCE / ACCESS:**
- TabPFN v2: priorlabs-1-1 (Apache-2.0 + attribution; full text UNVERIFIED). Record it in `registry/` as a model-licence row.
- TabPFN-2.5 weights must NOT be used (non-commercial; r_transition_ml).
- LightGBM MIT, CatBoost Apache-2.0, PyMC Apache-2.0 (from knowledge; UNVERIFIED this run).
- FDC CC0 (manifest says unverified).

**PASS GATE** (pre-registered in `phase_g_preregistration_v1.csv`):
- **G30-A (G15-2):** D0–D6 reported on every eligible headline split. D6 counts as "eligible" unless the activation rule (SSOT L22017–22025) excludes it, with the reason recorded before results.
- **G30-B (G15-9):** a D7 variant is ACCEPTED iff, on ≥2 of the 4 cold families (food, process, compound/target, pair), it beats max-performance(D3-full, D5-tuned, D6) with paired-cluster lower bound > δ_30 (PROPOSED_PILOT, e.g. 0.005 RF on the fraction scale; set before run), and does not worsen worst-cluster coverage by > 0.05. Otherwise REJECTED.
- **G30-C (complexity promotion of D5/D6 over D3-full/D4):** same margin rule on the TB primary cold splits (MP AM5).
- **G30-D (G15-6, PE-only):** study-disjoint empirical coverage ≥ coverage floor c_floor (PROPOSED 0.85 at nominal 0.90) with group-disjoint calibration. If below, the rung cannot enter the Step-36 MODEL rung.
- The step **passes** when G30-A and G30-D are reported and G30-B/C are decided. A REJECTED G30-B is a valid pass.

**FAIL ACTION:**
- G30-A fails (D6 unrunnable): the activation-rule ineligibility record must exist before results, otherwise G15-2 stays OPEN.
- G30-B REJECTED: completion stays a retrieval/VoI ranking aid only (SSOT L23933). C9 = best of D3-full/D4. Feed the D3-full posterior variance to Step 14 VoI (forward failure: OOD collapse → acquire data, not deeper architecture).
- G30-D fails: the C9 transition route outputs QUALITATIVE/ABSTAIN outside random-split domains; G15-6 remains unmet.
- Cold collapse for every rung: freeze "lookup + hierarchical fallback" as the production estimator, invoke §215.70, and stop deeper modelling on D-A.

**FALLBACK:**
- If the GLMM fails to converge: use an empirical-Bayes crossed-effects approximation (additive shrunken effects).
- If FM/soft-impute is not ready: report D7a only and mark G15-9 "partially tested" (not ACCEPTED).

**PARALLEL WORK:** Steps 10–14, 16–25, 26a, 35-explicit. Step 31a can share the harness (it runs as an ablation arm).

**NEXT IF PASS:** Step 31 (condition/physics ablation on the PE measured-conditions subset). Step 36 C9 spec update.

**STOP FOR REVIEW:** After the G15-9 decision record and the C9 spec.

### AUDIT — Step 30
- **CURRENT STATUS evidence:**
  - DEL-2 reports (D6 SKIPPED; D7 ≡ D1 on PE, checked);
  - WORKLOG S017 L115 (propensity "from marginal frequencies");
  - ssot_sparsity §3.8 (D7 never beats D5 on USDA/Bognár);
  - `baselines.py` D3 nests only target×process.
- **PURPOSE:** Settle the strong-tabular floor and accept or reject sparse completion with honest cold/MNAR evaluation.
- **WHY NECESSARY:** G15-2/G15-9 are mandatory SSOT gates. The SSOT forbids D10 before D0–D7 (L18607).
- **DEPENDENCIES:**
  - HARD: 29, 15.
  - SOFT: 12 (FDC side info), 13 (propensity universe), 08 (year/platform covariates).
  - PARALLEL: 31a harness.
  - OPTIONAL: 35 (molecule descriptors for cold compound).
  - HUMAN: environment authorisation; RDKit approval if cold-compound is run.

  - RESEARCH: censored GBDT objective check (minor).
  - COMPUTE: none.
- **SCIENTIFIC QUESTION:** Does hierarchical or low-rank side-information structure transfer process effects to cold foods, processes or compounds beyond persistence and lookup, and does MNAR adjustment change the conclusion?
- **ENGINEERING QUESTION:** Can D3-full (censored GLMM), D6 (CPU) and D7d/e be added to the harness with identical folds, nested tuning and group-disjoint conformal?
- **KNOWN EVIDENCE:**
  - DEL-2 negative cold results; propensity AUC 0.81–0.91 (strong MNAR);
  - IID benchmark literature (trees ≈ best);
  - TabPFN random-split-only evidence.
- **UNKNOWN / UNCERTAIN:**
  - whether D3-full beats D0/D4 cold;
  - whether FM side features rescue D7;
  - whether D6 helps cold;
  - the propensity universe definition;
  - censored-objective tooling.
- **CONFIDENCE:** MEDIUM.
- **RESEARCH REQUIRED? / COMPLETED / RESULT:** Yes (model families, D6, conformal). Completed (r_transition_ml, r_eval_splits, TabPFN card). Result: add D3-full/D3-R/D5-tuned/D6/D7d/e; D6 comparator only; group conformal. Further reading is not useful; a pilot is cheaper (stop rule 5).
- **ALTERNATIVES CONSIDERED:**
  - deep tabular (FT-Transformer/TabM/RealMLP) as headline: rejected (IID-only evidence, n_eff ~100s);
  - GP headline: deferred (no meaningful cold kernel; MTGP transfer cancels in block designs, Bonilla et al. 2007);
  - neural CF/LightGCN: banned before MF/FM/Bayesian (SSOT L23892);
  - TabPFN-2.5: rejected (licence);
  - TabPFN as production: rejected.
- **SIMPLE BASELINE:** D0/D1/D2.
- **STRONG BASELINE:** D3-full crossed random effects; D4 lookup; D5-tuned.
- **OPTIONAL ADVANCED MODEL:** D6 TabPFN v2; D7d FM / D7b BPMF.
- **NEGATIVE CONTROLS:** target shuffle within source; matrix-ID-only memorisation probe; source-family-only shortcut; randomised side-features (FM with permuted FDC vectors).
- **ABLATIONS:** censoring arms; mask on/off; IPW on/off; side-information on/off; tuning budget.
- **FAILURE MODES:**
  - popular-cell illusion;
  - mask/platform shortcut;
  - propensity variance blow-up;
  - D7 implementation bug;
  - side-feature circularity (FDC cooked imputed from R6);
  - TabPFN context leakage;
  - over-reading Bognár templated factors.
- **STOP CONDITION:** §215.70 triggers (cold-pair collapse, retrieval matches advanced models) → freeze the simple estimator and stop D-A modelling depth.
- **DOWNSTREAM DEPENDENCIES:**
  - 31 (harness, best non-kinetic tabular = comparator for G15-5);
  - 33 (pure-ML arm);
  - 36 (C9 fallback, MODEL rung eligibility, completed-cell class);

- **ESTIMATED EFFORT:** agent 6–10 days; Kush 4–6 h; Parv 2 h; expert 2 h.
- **COMPUTE CLASS:** CPU sufficient (GPU helpful only for TabPFN speed); A100 unnecessary.
- **FINAL RECOMMENDATION:** MODIFY.
- **DECISION-MATRIX VALUE:** MODIFY.

## STEP 31 — Physics / condition features

**STEP ID:** 31 (substeps 31a, 31b)

**TITLE:** Physics / condition features. This is a pre-declared condition-contribution ablation on rows with measured conditions. It is not a new model family.

**STATUS:**
- NOT STARTED. No feature code exists; DEL-2 D5 uses categorical + mask features only (r_transition_ml).
- Data constraint: USDA has 0 rows with measured T; Bognár has 0 rows with measured duration; PE has both on 1,561 rows.
- Only 213 temperature entries are location-valid. Moisture/pH/aw are 0%.
- The Step-07 condition human audit is NOT_COUNTED_PROVENANCE_INVALID (`reports/step07/step07h_human_gate_result.json`). Packet v4 is unlabelled.
- A content bug (calendar months stored as fixed seconds) is noted (r_eval_splits Q0).

**GOAL:** Test RQ15-2 and G14-7 / G15-3. Do explicit continuous conditions and physics-derived exposure features improve held-out-condition and process-family-disjoint prediction over process labels and raw T,t alone? Do this on identical row sets, with effect sizes and CIs, and without imputing UNKNOWN conditions.

**SSOT ANCHORS:**
- §198.3 physics exposure features as "features/inductive biases, not proof of mechanism" (L15834–15847);
- §199.3–199.7 raw-first storage, transforms, POINT/INTERVAL/QUALITATIVE/UNKNOWN (L16105–16207); §199.8 endpoint leakage (L16209–16233);
- §201.12 soft physics constraints only for valid subsets (L16752–16762);
- §210.12–210.14 thermal dose Ω, representative-Ea features, log(1+t), 1/T_K (L18816–18876); moisture gating only with evidence (L18878–18896);
- §211.49 multi-fidelity bridge (L19794–19804);
- §215.56 endpoint ablations A0–A8, A5 "+physics features" (L22466–22484);
- §215.71 practical order: physics features before kinetics (L22707–22722) vs §216.7 DAG: kinetic fits → physics features (L22914–22918) (conflict C2);
- G14-7 (L17084); G15-3, G15-5 (L22384–22386).

**SCIENTIFIC RATIONALE:**
- Process labels conflate conditions. The thermal-dose formalism implies that log t, 1/T and Arrhenius exposure integrals linearise condition effects for small-data learners.
- These remain hypotheses (SSOT L18856, L18876). They are testable only where conditions are measured and vary within the data.
- An honest negative result here ("conditions add no value") triggers the §215.70 stop clause "conditions add no value".

**WHY NOW:**
- 31a is cheap and reuses the Step-30 harness.
- Its result decides whether Step 32's kinetic fits must beat a strong condition-aware tabular comparator (G15-5) and which features Step 36 C9 uses.
- 31b (fitted-parameter features) must wait for Step 32 / 26a outputs. This resolves the C2 conflict: the SSOT permits generic representative-Ea features without fitting (L18856).

**INPUT ARTIFACTS:**
- Step 30 harness and frozen manifests;
- COND typed values with completeness_mask and temperature-location registry (`registry/measurement_location_registry_v1.csv`);
- `registry/heat_transfer_mode_registry_v1.csv`;
- **valid Step-07 human audit result (packet v4)**;
- Step 24 registry rows giving literature Ea values for the representative-Ea grid (look-ahead);
- for 31b: Step 32 / 26a fitted (k_ref, Ea) posteriors.

**REQUIRED RESEARCH:**
- (a) Which representative Ea values to use. OPEN. This is a data decision: it must come from Step-24 registry literature values per target class, pre-declared. It is not further literature research for this step.
- (b) The error of setpoint vs product temperature in Ω. OPEN (ssot_l15a C11, Q6). Handle it by a sensitivity arm, not by reading.

**RESEARCH FINDINGS:**
- Food PIML is "in a development phase", mostly PDE/transport (Purlis 2024; metadata only).
- Hybrid/physics value arises with time-resolved data (von Stosch et al. 2014).
- The closest ML-vs-retention-factor paper had no conditions and no food-held-out split (Naravane & Tagkopoulos 2023).
- Monotone constraints for degradation-only targets are an SSOT-endorsed soft constraint (§201.12).
- The repo's PE has 152 pseudo-series from 26 publications, mostly storage (r_transition_ml; r_simulator_vv counts K1-like groups as mostly storage, with boil = 5). So condition variance is dominated by storage time and ambient/fridge temperature, not cooking. **Any 31a positive result on PE must be reported as "storage-condition" evidence unless it survives a cooking-only stratum.**

**ARCHITECTURE:**
- **31a — generic features (before Step 32):**
  - Row set R31 = rows with location-valid or explicitly typed T and measured t. On today's data that is effectively the PE subset; it expands with Steps 11–14.
  - Arms on identical R31 rows:
    - A1 process-only;
    - A3 ingredient+process;
    - A4 +raw T,t;
    - A5 +physics: log(1+t), 1/T_K, Ω at a pre-declared Ea grid of 3 values from Step-24 literature, time-above-threshold where a schedule exists, wet/dry/fat heat mode, water-contact/leaching proxy, basis and yield flags;
    - A5-M: +missing-indicator arm. UNKNOWN is never set to 0; trees use NaN plus indicators (SSOT L16207).
    - A5-C: monotone-constrained GBDT for degradation-only targets.
  - Learners: D3-full (with condition slopes) and D5-tuned.
  - Small baseline: GP over (log t, 1/T) per compound class on PE, for interpolation only.
- **Temperature-semantics sensitivity arm.** Location-valid only vs setpoint-included (flagged).
- **Splits:**
  - condition-OOD within study: hold out the highest T level and the longest t per study (Roberts et al. 2017 block design); interpolation vs extrapolation reported separately;
  - process-family-disjoint, leaf held out with parent retained (SSOT L22079);
  - lineage-disjoint (PE).
- **Feature-family grouped permutation importance** (SSOT §202.5), reported with the correlated-feature caveat.
- **31b — fitted-parameter features (after Step 32):** Ω computed with fitted (k_ref, Ea) posteriors for systems that passed G15-4. Re-test on the 31a splits. This is the multi-fidelity bridge (SSOT L19794–19804), labelled "focused-system-derived feature", with no universal transfer claim.

**DO:**
- Store raw values first and derive transforms deterministically.
- Pre-declare the Ea grid, splits and row set in `phase_g_preregistration_v1.csv`.
- Report effect size + paired cluster CI.
- Report the cooking-only stratum separately from storage.
- Keep endpoint phrases ("until golden") out of the inputs.

**DO NOT:**
- Impute missing T/t/pH/moisture as numbers.
- Map "medium heat" to a number without a flag (SSOT L16205).
- Estimate Arrhenius parameters from D-A aggregates (SSOT L19782–19792).
- Apply moisture gating without system evidence.
- Claim mechanism from feature importance.
- Run on condition values before the Step-07 human audit validly passes.

**OUTPUT ARTIFACTS:**
- `src` feature module spec: `reports/step31/physics_feature_spec_v1.md`, with formulas, units, Ea grid and sources.
- `registry/physics_feature_registry_v1.csv` (feature_id, formula, inputs, unit, validity domain, Ea source row id).
- `experiments/EXP-0000NN/`.
- `reports/step31/condition_contribution_results.md` (A1/A3/A4/A5 arms, per-split, cooking vs storage strata).
- `reports/step31/g14_7_g15_3_record.md`.
- §216.13 decision-record items 3–4.

**DATA REQUIREMENTS:**
- ≥K independent lineage components with within-study condition variation per tested target class (PROPOSED K = 10). Today that is likely met only by PE storage series (UNVERIFIED count of cooking-condition components; census needed in 31a.0).
- Steps 11–14 must deliver cooking-condition studies with ≥3 T levels.

**BASELINES:** A1 process-only; A3 ingredient+process (= Step 30 best); A4 raw T,t (the condition-label baseline G14-7 asks for).

**EXPERIMENTS / ABLATIONS:**
- E31-1: A3 vs A4 vs A5 (G14-7 and RQ15-2).
- E31-2: A5 vs A5-M (missingness handling; SSOT §202.7 missingness robustness, G14-8).
- E31-3: monotone constraint arm.
- E31-4: temperature-semantics sensitivity.

**METRICS:**

- extrapolation vs interpolation error;

**LEAKAGE CONTROLS:**

- No endpoint phrases as features.

**UNCERTAINTY / CONFIDENCE:**

**COMPUTE:** CPU sufficient; A100 unnecessary.

**HUMAN REVIEW:**
- The Step-07 condition audit (packet v4) must be validly completed by independent human reviewers. Owned by Step 07: the 07.x retro-fix, not Step 31's hours.
- An expert food scientist reviews the Ea grid, temperature semantics and heat-mode mapping (≈4 h).
- Kush signs the pre-registration.

**LICENCE / ACCESS:** No new data. PE redistribution restrictions apply to any released rows.

**PASS GATE** (pre-registered):
- **G31-A (validity):** Step-07 audit validly PASSED. R31 has ≥K components per tested target class, else the split is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.
- **G31-B (G14-7/G15-3):**

  - "Physics adds value" iff A5 beats A4 under the same rule.
  - Either outcome (yes/no) passes the step if G31-A holds.

**FAIL ACTION:**
- G31-A fails on audit → STOP. Return to Step 07 (07.x audit retro-fix); no condition-feature claims.
- G31-A fails on data → NEED_DATA. Send cooking-condition quotas (≥3 T levels, within-study) to Steps 11/14.
- G31-B "no value" → retain process-label tabular (Step 30 winner) as the C9 estimator, invoke the §215.70 "conditions add no value" stop clause for D-A, and record a negative result. Step 32 still proceeds on its own D-C data (its G15-5 comparator is then A4/A3).

**FALLBACK:** If R31 is too small, report descriptive within-study condition-response curves only (no model claim). The GP interpolation baseline serves Step 36 INTERPOLATE within the same study only.

**PARALLEL WORK:** 31a runs alongside Step 30 in the same harness; 26a fitting library; Steps 10–14.

**NEXT IF PASS:** Step 32 (focused kinetics), which inherits A4/A5 as its G15-5 comparator. 31b after Step 32.

**STOP FOR REVIEW:** After the G31-A check (before running), and after the G14-7/G15-3 record.

## STEP 32 — Focused kinetics

**STEP ID:** 32

**TITLE:** Focused kinetics. K0–K6 kinetic ablation and cross-study kinetic generalisation for the focused system(s), compared against Step 30/31 on the same study-disjoint tests.

**STATUS:**
- NOT STARTED. NEED_DATA.
- No KINETIC/trajectory ledger, no kinetic units in UNIT (ssot_l15a §1.9), no kinetic schema (impl notes).
- The repo's PE holds about 152 retention-vs-time pseudo-series from 26 publications (r_transition_ml), mostly storage.
- Series with ≥3 temperatures:
  - r_transition_ml: 29 series from 3 publications (≥3 T at a fixed time);
  - r_simulator_vv: 8 groups from 2 studies (≥3 T × ≥3 t).
  - These definitions differ; reconciliation is UNVERIFIED.
- No vitamin C, chlorophyll, acrylamide, HMF or starch series (r_simulator_vv).
- ES-1.2: kinetic sources SOURCE_GAP (13/16 cells). `time_series_available = no` for all 64 manifest rows (impl notes).

**GOAL:**
- For the focused system chosen in Step 26 (recommended SIM-AA-1, ascorbic acid in vegetables under water/steam heating, 60–100 °C; fallback SIM-CHL-1; r_simulator_vv) and optionally one second system, establish:
  - (i) which kinetic primary model (first-order, Weibull, fractional conversion, biphasic) generalises across studies, chosen by held-out performance;
  - (ii) identifiable reference-T Arrhenius parameters with hierarchical study/matrix effects and honest uncertainty (G15-4);
  - (iii) whether kinetic structure beats the Step-30/31 best non-kinetic model on held-out temperature (precursor of G15-5).
- **The single-system fitting/identifiability machinery is owned by Step 26a and reused here, not rebuilt.**

**SSOT ANCHORS:**
- §208.4 rungs "multiple times at one condition → rate k", "times × temperatures → Arrhenius" (L18033–18056);
- §210 kinetic library, incl. reference-T Arrhenius (L19146–19160), Weibull "only if simpler models fail" (L19032–19042), degradation vs leaching (L18987–19000);
- §210.28 K0–K4 (L19089–19109); §210.29 / §211.50 / §216.2 kinetic schemas (L19111–19135, L19806–19826, L22800–22823);
- §211 fitting protocol: NLS/MLE, censored likelihood, profile likelihood, study-level bootstrap, within-study first then pooling, LOTO/LOSO CV, AICc + held-out (L19216–19853);
- pilot design rule ≥3–4 T × ≥4–5 t (L19162); ≥5 obs/parameter, condition number ~1e6 warning (L19841);
- §215.14 kinetic evaluation; §215.57 K0–K6 ablation (L22486–22500);
- §224.4 identifiability-driven acquisition (L24304–24314);
- G15-4 (L22385), G15-5 (L22386).

**SCIENTIFIC RATIONALE:**
- Endpoint data do not identify dynamics (permanent rule 2, SSOT L18018). Kinetic claims require K1/K2 series.
- Food kinetic parameters are matrix-dependent: ascorbic acid Ea spans ~12 to >130 kJ/mol across matrices (Giannakourou & Taoukis 2021, Foods 10:2630; r_simulator_vv).
- So the scientifically meaningful question is cross-study and cross-matrix generalisation of a hierarchical kinetic model, tested study-disjointly. A single-paper fit is not enough.
- Study random effects dominate in food meta-analyses (Karamcheti et al. 2025).

**WHY NOW:**
- It runs only after:
  - (a) Steps 10–14 deliver K1/K2 series for the focused system;
  - (b) Step 15 freezes SIM-CALIBRATION / SIM-VALIDATION / DOWNSTREAM-TEST partitions;
  - (c) Step 26a exists.
- It can run before, or in parallel with, Step 27 on the *downstream* partition. But its parameters must not be fitted on Step-27 validation studies.
- Placed at its spine position it is fine. **The correction is that its machinery is a hidden prerequisite of Step 26 and moves there (26a).**

**INPUT ARTIFACTS:**
- KINETIC/trajectory ledger: `ledgers/data/KIN.jsonl` (new, schema = union of §210.29 + §211.50 + §216.2, per SCR / Step 04 unification; ssot_l15a C10). Raw timepoints are stored separately from fitted parameters.
- Step 24 formula/model registry entries (law, units by order, T_ref);
- Step 25 parameter-compatibility retrieval;
- Step 26a library;
- Step 15 partitions;
- Step 08 lineage at research-group level;
- Step 30/31 comparators on identical rows.

**REQUIRED RESEARCH:**
- (a) Choice of first system. DONE by r_simulator_vv: AA first (MEDIUM–HIGH), chlorophyll fallback. Acrylamide/Maillard are RESEARCH_ONLY extensions (SCR proposed by the Phase-F drafter on §210.29A).
- (b) Data availability. PARTIAL: AA has the largest literature pool (OpenAlex 15,482 vs 1,227 for potato acrylamide kinetics; upper bounds; r_acquisition). The decision is the Step 10/11 **extractability census** (2–3 human-days), not more reading.
- (c) Identifiability reporting standard. Profile likelihood (Raue et al. 2009, Bioinformatics; UNVERIFIED this run) and study-level bootstrap per SSOT §211.

**RESEARCH FINDINGS:**
- The neural ODE/CDE/UDE family (Chen 2018; Kidger 2020; Rackauckas 2020) needs trajectories. It is deferred (D11) until ≥20 time-resolved series from ≥5 independent studies exist for one system (r_transition_ml, PROPOSED).
- One-step global fitting gives more honest uncertainty than two-step fitting (r_simulator_vv Q4; SSOT §211.10).
- First-order is adequate for blanching in several reports (Cruz et al. 2008). Weibull is an alternative selected by held-out fit, not AIC alone.
- AA loss mixes degradation and leaching, and retention may be apparent or yield-corrected (Delchier et al. 2014, metadata). A degradation-only model on boiling data is a mandatory negative control.

**ARCHITECTURE:**
- **32.0 Census gate.** Count K1/K2 series meeting inclusion (geometry, water ratio, analyte basis AA vs AA+DHA, method, replicates) per independent research group. Use Step-11/14 quotas from r_simulator_vv: ≥30 K1+ series from ≥10 groups, ≥5 matrices, ≥3 groups with K2 designs (PROPOSED).
- **32.1 Kinetic ablation ladder (SSOT §215.57)** on the DOWNSTREAM-TEST partition (study-disjoint):
  - K0 mean/null (= Step 30 best non-kinetic on these rows);
  - K1 time-only;
  - K2 empirical (T,t) = Step 31 A4/A5 tabular;
  - K3 simple kinetic law (first-order / Weibull / fractional conversion / biphasic, each fitted within study first);
  - K4 global reference-T Arrhenius with hierarchical log k_ref and Ea by matrix class plus study random effects (SSOT §211.21, §211.37–39);
  - K5 +gating (pH/O2/moisture) only if those inputs exist; otherwise "NOT_TESTABLE" (today pH/moisture are 0%);
  - K6 hybrid = Step 33.
  - **Leaching term** included where water is assayed (mass balance), else the leaching-confounded flag is set.
- **32.2 Identifiability:**
  - profile likelihood for k_ref and Ea;
  - Fisher/condition-number diagnostic;
  - parameter-recovery check on synthetic data from 26a (E7 identifiability use is permitted pre-Step-27; SSOT §223.4);
  - LOTO and LOSO CV.
- **32.3 Second system** (chlorophyll, or acrylamide/Maillard RESEARCH_ONLY) only after Step 27 PASS for the first.
- **32.4 Outputs to registries.** Fitted parameter sets → PARAM ledger with `effective_or_mechanistic`, fit T/t ranges, CI method, identifiability status, calibration_source lineage. §211.50 minimal kinetic report per fit.

**DO:**
- Fit within study before pooling.
- Use censored likelihood for <LOD points.
- Keep orders and units distinct (never harmonise k across orders; SSOT L19184).
- Propagate first-stage uncertainty.
- Report fit vs predictive uncertainty separately.
- Keep author-reported fits separate from project re-fits.

**DO NOT:**
- Estimate Arrhenius from D-A aggregates.
- Select by R² or AIC alone.
- Pool parameters with incompatible definitions.
- Refit simulator parameters independently of 26a/25 (duplication).
- Use Step-27 validation studies for any fit.
- Run neural ODE/UDE.

**OUTPUT ARTIFACTS:**
- `ledgers/data/KIN.jsonl` (rows extracted in Steps 09–14; schema frozen in Step 04/24);
- `ledgers/data/PARAM.jsonl` entries;
- `reports/step32/kinetic_census.md`;
- `reports/step32/kinetic_ablation_K0_K6.md`;
- `reports/step32/identifiability_report.md`;
- per-fit `reports/step32/fits/<system>_<group>.md` (§211.50 fields);
- `reports/step32/g15_4_record.md`;
- §216.13 decision-record item 6.

**DATA REQUIREMENTS:**
- D-C / K1–K2 series for the focused system meeting 32.0 quotas.
- Raw timepoints with SD/n, temperature schedule with location, medium, water ratio, piece geometry, analyte basis, method.
- Study and research-group lineage.
- **None exists in the repo today** → NEED_DATA.

**BASELINES:**
- K0 (Step 30 best non-kinetic);
- K2 empirical tabular (Step 31 A4/A5);
- D4 nearest-evidence within matrix;
- persistence.

**EXPERIMENTS / ABLATIONS:**
- E32-1: K0–K5 ladder;
- E32-2: primary-model selection by held-out fit;
- E32-3: two-stage vs global Arrhenius;
- E32-4: pooled vs hierarchical vs per-matrix;
- E32-5: degradation-only vs degradation+leaching on boiling data (negative control);
- E32-6: wrong-matrix parameters (negative control);
- E32-7: shuffled temperature (negative control).

**METRICS:**
- ln(C/C0) error per timepoint; trajectory RMSE;
- held-out-temperature error (extrapolation) vs interpolation;
- 80/95% interval coverage and width; CRPS;
- profile-likelihood CI width for Ea and k_ref;
- condition number;
- study-bootstrap CIs.

**LEAKAGE CONTROLS:**
- Partition membership frozen at Step 15 before any fit.
- Parameter calibration sources must be a subset of training lineage components (automatic check against PARAM `calibration_source`).
- Held-out temperature bands are never seen in Ea estimation.
- Digitised-figure uncertainty is carried.
- The same paper's series stay in one fold (group by research group).

**UNCERTAINTY / CONFIDENCE:** MEDIUM–LOW. Data availability and reporting completeness (U1 in r_simulator_vv) dominate. Methods are HIGH.

**COMPUTE:** CPU sufficient (SciPy least_squares/solve_ivp, lmfit, PyMC/NumPyro). A100 unnecessary.

**HUMAN REVIEW:**
- Expert food-kinetics review of model forms, parameter plausibility (sign/magnitude/units; SSOT L19578–19588) and the leaching interpretation (≈8–12 h).
- Human verification of every LLM-extracted kinetic row used in test/calibration (G15-H; owned by Step 09/11 queues).
- Kush signs the G15-4 record.

**LICENCE / ACCESS:**
- Kinetic literature is per-article (CC-BY OA vs closed). The licence posture for storing digitised timepoints from closed papers is unresolved (ssot_l15a §5.3); it needs a Step 06/08 policy.
- Fitted parameters are derived data; record attribution.

**PASS GATE** (pre-registered):
- **G32-A (G15-4):** ≥1 focused system has a K4 hierarchical fit where:
  - (i) the profile-likelihood 95% CIs for Ea and ln k_ref are finite and bounded within pre-declared plausibility ranges;
  - (ii) the LOSO-predicted 90% interval coverage ∈ [0.80, 0.97] (PROPOSED, consistent with Step 27);
  - (iii) residual diagnostics show no monotone bias in T.
- **G32-B (G15-5 precursor):** K3/K4 beats K2 tabular on held-out temperature with paired cluster LB > δ_32 (PROPOSED_PILOT). Report the result; it is decided jointly with Step 33.
- The step passes on G32-A. A G32-B "no" is a valid negative result.

**FAIL ACTION:**
- 32.0 census fails → NEED_DATA. Send identifiability-designed quotas (SSOT §224.4) to Steps 11/14. Use E7 identifiability studies to choose which T/t to acquire. Do not proceed to 33.
- G32-A fails (unidentifiable) → mark the system RESEARCH_ONLY in the registry. The transition route stays D3-full/D4 (Step 30). Record the negative result. No D9/D11. Consider the pre-registered fallback system (chlorophyll).
- G32-B "no" → kinetic structure is not used in C9. The tabular result is retained (law: complexity must beat simple).

**FALLBACK:** If only K1 (single-T) series exist: report rate constants per T with CIs as "K1 descriptive". No Arrhenius claim.

**PARALLEL WORK:** Step 27 (on separate partitions); acquisition 11–14 continuing; Step 35; Step 36 build.

**NEXT IF PASS:** Step 33 (mechanistic vs ML vs hybrid). 31b (fitted-Ω features). Second system (32.3) after Step 27 PASS.

**STOP FOR REVIEW:** After the 32.0 census; after the G15-4 record.
