## C. Brief §0 per-step questions (Step 36)

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Objective correct? | Yes, in direction (SSOT §230 L25116–25121). It needs sharpening into falsifiable claims: G36-* plus RQ16-02/03/05/06/30. |
| Necessary? | Yes. It is the only home of G16-EVID/CAL/DEC/PROV and the §257P final-claims checklist, and the consumer that justifies many earlier fields. |
| Placed correctly? | The evaluated form is correctly last. Schema (36A) and benchmark protocol (36B) are mis-placed if left until the end, because they generate backward requirements and the human long pole. PARALLELIZE them. |
| Dependencies correct? | The spine implies 35→36. The real hard edges are 15, 08, 09, 07I-C, 19, D-008. 29–35 are soft: the MODEL rung and FlavorTwin are optional, and their absence is a valid state. |
| Data requirement realistic? | Partly. Evidence is enough for a benchmark that mostly tests QUALITATIVE/ABSTAIN behaviour honestly. Calibration labels are the bottleneck (0 today). Genuine conflict cases and volatile data are NEED_DATA. |
| Architecture technically sound? | Yes, with the modifications listed (structured-first, harmonise-first conflicts, non-scalar profile, rule cascade + small calibrators, template generator). |
| Baselines appropriate? | Yes: SSOT B0–B7 plus always-answer, scalar-threshold, LLM-confidence and majority-conflict controls. |
| Metrics sufficient? | Add per-hard-negative-type AUROC, E-AURC, debiased ECE, ALCE citation P/R, silent-upgrade count and worst-cluster coverage. |
| Gates scientifically meaningful? | Not yet: G16-* have no numbers. Pre-register the G36-* operational versions. |
| Literature suggests better approach? | No better overall approach. The literature *confirms* dropping generic CE, rejecting LLM self-abstention, Platt over isotonic, and empirical-only cold coverage. |
| Simpler approach sufficient? | Possibly. B5 rule cascade + B5T template may be retained if B7 calibration does not earn itself. That is a valid outcome. |
| Missing artifact? | Yes: PKT v2 schema, RCL runtime claim ledger, support-enum crosswalk, certainty-profile spec, fallback whitelist, seal/access log, IDT schema. |
| Duplicating another step? | Partly. 25 parameter-compatibility retrieval reuses the 36A compatibility machinery; share the code, keep the contracts separate. L13E historical RAG overlaps 36C.9 and is deferred. |
| Parallel safely? | 36A ∥ 08–15; 36B ∥ 08–20; 36D-static ∥ 35. |
| Reduce? | Yes. DEFER 36C.9 (historical) and 36D.2/36D.3. RQ16-18/19 diagnosis/recovery only if gold exists. |
| Research before implementation? | Done. Pilots P1/P2 now dominate. |
| STOP trigger | §249.2 conditions; G36-A fail; locked-test contamination. |
| MODIFY trigger | Structured does not beat hybrid on human items → retriever change. Calibration fails under shift → drop probabilistic claims. |
| KEEP trigger | G36-RET/CAL/ABST pass. |
| NEED_DATA trigger | Tier <240 for paired claims; <30 conflict cases; no volatile data (36D.2); empty whitelist (MODEL rung). |

## E. FORWARD FAILURE PROPAGATION (every Step 36 gate)

| Gate | If it fails | Route |
|---|---|---|
| G36-A | Packets invalid / non-replayable / silent upgrades | Fix compiler (36A); no evaluation; no claims |
| G36-B | Agreement below floor / provenance invalid / tier <240 | Revise guidelines, relabel fresh sample (never toward the system); tier <240 → descriptive-only; P1 too small → RQ16-03 stays NEED_DATA |
| G36-RET | Structured ≤ hybrid on human items | Stop rule §249.2: keep B2 retriever; repair slot parsing (16–17) / linking; drop compatibility classifier; record negative |
| G36-RET (slot failures dominate) | Oracle-vs-predicted gap large | Repair upstream (C1 lexicons, Step 16–17 extraction), not retrieval |
| G36-CONF | Harmoniser ≤ majority, or too few conflicts | Report conflicts descriptively (REPORT_CONFLICT still mandatory); acquire genuine conflict cells (Steps 10–14); NEED_DATA |
| G36-CAL | Uncalibrated / ECE CI wide / under-coverage on cold | Stop rule: no probability claims; ordinal profile + empirical RC only; acquire independent gold (Step 19 DG-3) |
| G36-ABST | Over-claim | Tighten rung predicates / precision cap |
| G36-ABST | Over-abstention | Report trade-off; keep simpler B5; revisit INTERPOLATE predicates with human sufficiency labels |
| G36-TRANS | No model whitelisted | MODEL rung off → QUALITATIVE/ABSTAIN; not a Step 36 failure; feed demand to Steps 14/30 |
| G36-TRANS | Model whitelisted but UCR rises | Remove from whitelist (§249.2 "L15 adds coverage but increases unsupported claims") |
| G36-DEC | B7 not better than B5 | Keep B5/B6; feasibility removing gold-valid actions → relax rules / fix ontology (Steps 16, 21) |
| G36-OOD | Cold strata collapse | Acquire data rather than deepen architecture (brief §40); widen abstention on both-new |
| G36-LOCK | Locked test touched for tuning | Burn the locked set; author a fresh locked set; label previous results exploratory (H5) |
| G36-FT | Process-conditioned ≤ static | Ship static FlavorTwin with evidence gating; process claim DEFERRED/NEED_DATA |
| G15-INV (36D.3) | Forward gates fail | Inverse search blocked; I0 counterfactual COMPARE only |

## Look-ahead / backward requirements pushed onto earlier steps

- (G_A) 01: namespace registry (01.3) needed by 04 because SIM-/MODEL-/MEAS-/EXP-/CLM- collisions must be resolved before 04.1/04.9 reserve new prefixes
- (G_A) 01: pre-registered threshold registry (01.6) needed by 04 and 08 because the giant-component share, edge-precision Wilson lower bound and seeded-copy recall must be fixed before lineage is computed
- (G_A) 01: D-027 MP-1 status ruling needed by 03/04 because the v1.1 addenda must know which v1 fields are frozen (consumed by ES-1.1) and which are open (C2-C8)
- (G_A) 02: count-definition reconciliation (02.6) needed by 03/04 because several notes use ledger line counts as id counts (ING 5,387 lines vs 2,110 ids; PROC 552 vs 156; TOOL 297 vs 119; EVD 57,280 vs 18,156 vs 17,978)
- (G_A) 02: environment manifest (02.3) needed by 03/04 validators and by Steps 29-35 because Linux system python lacks pandas/pyarrow and RDKit status is UNVERIFIED
- (G_A) 03: field_status/claim_route trichotomy (03.1) needed by 04.5 because provenance v1.1 and claim language depend on a shared status model
- (G_A) 03: clock registry (03.3) needed by 04.3 because the KINETIC schema needs tagged process time and temperature schedules
- (G_A) 03: belief->plane mapping (03.8) needed by 04.6 because STATE/EVT rows span recipe-semantic, episode and model planes
- (G_A) BACKWARD from 08 onto 04: three independence keys, lineage edge types, DOC/STUDY/SEXP/SMP/OBS/AGG/DRV definitions (04.1) needed because Step 08 computes them
- (G_A) BACKWARD from 09-14 onto 04: unified KINETIC/trajectory schema, DIGITIZED flag, dispersion/n/basis/method per observation, document type (04.2/04.3) needed because otherwise series are flattened and inverse-variance/censored methods impossible
- (G_A) BACKWARD from 15/07I-C/16-20 onto 04: split contract with CALIBRATION partition, claim_id, feasibility_status and recipe split_group_id (04.8) needed because no split may be frozen without it
- (G_A) BACKWARD from 16-18 onto 03/04: entity lifecycle/parentage, event_kind/modality/alternatives, COND source_plane firewall (03.4/03.5/04.6) needed because EVT.condition_id would otherwise write recipe-stated conditions into the evidence COND ledger
- (G_A) BACKWARD from 19 onto 04: annotation provenance (MODEL_ASSISTED_HUMAN_REVIEWED vs INDEPENDENT_HUMAN vs ADJUDICATED) and blind-packet hash commitments (04.5/04.10) needed because all 40 existing Gold recipes are AI-drafted and Deep Gold must be anchoring-free
- (G_A) BACKWARD from 21-28 onto 03/04: history-dependent state variables, fit_origin AUTHOR_REPORTED vs PROJECT_FIT, reserved MECH-/EFFSIG-/FMOD-/PARAM-/VAL-/APPDEC-/SIMRUN- namespaces, SIM plane separate from evidence (03.6/03.9/04.3/04.9) needed because applicability, registries and simulators otherwise reuse colliding prefixes and mislabel simulation as evidence
- (G_A) BACKWARD from 29-34 onto 03: delta_semantics, target-rung eligibility, evidence_cutoff prefix semantics, censor kinds incl. ROUNDED_INTERVAL (03.2/03.6/03.8) needed because transition targets, endpoint-phrase leakage control and censored likelihood depend on them
- (G_A) BACKWARD from 35 onto 04: typed similarity registry v1.1 with nulls, split families and fingerprint spec (04.7) needed because no universal similarity scalar is allowed and FP2/ECFP4-count/Morgan-r2/PubChem-881 specs conflict
- (G_A) BACKWARD from 36 onto 04: compatibility tri-state, match types, certainty-profile domains, recommendation labels, RCLM- runtime claim namespace (04.9/04.11) needed because the evidence packet and cascade must not use a scalar confidence or confuse research claims with response claims
- (G_B) 01: authority ruling replacing S133 'Step 08 only after the gate' with a SOFT dependency (07-DEP) needed by 08 because lineage does not depend on condition values and the hard edge blocks the critical path

# ===== I1_evidence_model =====
# I1 — Scientific evidence model (brief §18): SOURCE → DOCUMENT → STUDY → EXPERIMENT → SAMPLE → MEASUREMENT → AGGREGATE → DERIVED

Author: G_B (Phase B drafter), 2026-10-22. PLAN-RESEARCH ONLY. Nothing here was implemented. The repo was read-only.

**Provenance.**
- The 36-step plan is missing. Step ownership here is reconstructed.
- The design adopts and tightens `research/r_evidence_model.md` (HIGH/MEDIUM-HIGH). It is consistent with:
  - SSOT §232.6 (L25307–25310), Split 6 (L16886–16891), §220.8 (L23656–23667), §257F.3–F.7 (L34715–34765), §210.29 (L19111–19136), §216.2 (L22800–22824), G15-1/G15-H (L22382, L22395);
  - MP AH1 (L2759–2787), AM3 (L3597–3613), W4/W5 (L1573–1687).
- Literature verification levels are as stated in `r_evidence_model`. All thresholds are PROPOSED_PILOT.
- New SSOT text is requested only through `ssot_change_requests` (PROPOSED_ONLY).

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Design principles

1. **The unit of evidence is the study, not the report and not the row.** Multiple reports of one study count once (Cochrane Handbook v6.5 ch. 5). Re-reports, mirrors and compilations are one lineage (SSOT L25307–25310).
2. **Layering follows ISA, lineage edges follow PROV, sample / observation / procedure follow SOSA.**
   - ISA: Investigation / Study / Assay; Source → Sample → Data DAG; factors and protocol parameters.
   - W3C PROV-DM/PROV-O: Quotation, PrimarySource, Revision, alternateOf, qualifiedDerivation, Bundles.
   - W3C SOSA/SSN: Sample, Observation, Procedure.
   - Value documentation reuses EuroFIR categories (Value Type, Method Indicator, Acquisition Type, Matrix Unit) and the FAO/INFOODS archival → reference → user levels.
   - These are **semantic mappings over the existing JSONL ledgers**, not runtime storage. An optional PROV-JSON export is produced at the Step 15 freeze (FAIR R1.2).
3. **EVD stays the consumer view** (the SSOT evidence atom, L25248–25262). The hierarchy lives *under* it. EVD rows point into it. Nothing in EVD v1 or the ledger is rewritten (append-only law).
4. **No invention.** Any layer that cannot be identified from the source is recorded as `NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FROM_SOURCE` with a reason. Fabricating a study, sample or n to fill a schema is forbidden (MP AH1; project law "no scientific value may be invented to fill a schema").
5. **Endpoint and trajectory are both first-class.** A time series is many OBS on SAMPLEs within one EXPERIMENT, plus a KIN series record. It is never flattened to an endpoint (SSOT L22800–22824: "Raw timepoint measurements remain available separately").
6. **Regimes are never flattened** (SSOT L23445–23464: D-A aggregated retention, D-B raw-vs-processed panels, D-C focused kinetics, D-D recipe corpora). Every record carries `regime`.
7. **Planes are separate.**
   - SOURCE / SCIENTIFIC EVIDENCE memory is defined here.
   - Recipe text (TEXT_STATED), model estimates (MODEL_ESTIMATED / IMPUTED, class I) and simulation (SIMULATED, E7) never enter these ledgers as OBS (SSOT §223.14 L24249–24255; MP L595).
   - Occurrence databases (EFSA acrylamide, AGE tables) live in an OCCURRENCE sub-plane. They supply plausibility bounds only.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 2. Entity chain, prefixes and mandatory fields

Prefix rule:
- `MEAS-` keeps its meaning as the **method/procedure** ledger (SOSA Procedure).
- `EXP-` keeps its meaning as **ML/benchmark runs**.
- New scientific entities get non-colliding prefixes.

Every mandatory field may hold an explicit status (`UNKNOWN`, `NOT_REPORTED_BY_SOURCE`, `NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FROM_SOURCE`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`). It may never hold `0` or `""` (SSOT §257C template L29343–29350).

| # | Entity (prefix) | Status in repo | Standard analogue | Mandatory fields | Cardinality |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **SOURCE** (`SRC-`) | EXISTS (609 lines; schema has kind, title, doi, url, year, authors, publisher, licence, licence_status, storage_rule, primary_or_secondary, source_family_id) | EuroFIR Reference; PROV Entity+Agent | id, kind ∈ {ARTICLE, DATABASE_RELEASE, REPORT, BOOK, REVIEW, WEBPAGE, DATASET, AUTHORITY_STANDARD, PROJECT}, title, persistent_id (DOI/PMID/ISBN/URL) or status, release/version, year, authors/publisher, **licence + licence_status + storage_rule**, primary_or_secondary, **source_family_id (always)**, retrieved_at (via SNAP-) | 1 SRC → ≥0 DOC |
| 1b | **SNAPSHOT** (`SNAP-`) | EXISTS (347) | PROV Bundle / retrieval activity | source_id, retrieval timestamp, URL/DOI, version/ETag, content hash, licence snapshot, raw-storage permission, parser version (MP X5 L2016–2025) | 1 SRC → ≥0 SNAP |
| 2 | **DOCUMENT** (`DOC-`) | NEW (Step 08) | PROV specializationOf / alternateOf | id, src_id, snap_id, manifestation_kind ∈ {PDF, HTML, XML, TABLE_FILE, RELEASE_TXT, SUPPLEMENT}, sha256 **or** acquisition_status = NOT_ACQUIRED, edition/version, page_count, parser/OCR tool + version, licence (inherited), is_review ∈ {PRIMARY, REVIEW, SECONDARY, COMPILATION} | DOC ↔ STUDY many-to-many via `report_doc_ids` |

| 9 | **LINEAGE edge** (`LIN-`) | NEW (Step 08) | PROV relations | id, from_id, to_id (SRC/DOC/STUDY/SEXP/SMP/OBS/AGG), **type** ∈ {SAME_STUDY_AS, QUOTES_VALUES_FROM (prov:Quotation), PRIMARY_SOURCE (compilation→primary), REVISION_OF (release), ALTERNATE_OF (same doc, other format), SHARES_SAMPLES_WITH, SHARES_REFERENCE_SAMPLE, SAME_LAB_AS, CITES (non-merging)}, detection_method ∈ {DOI_PMID_EXACT, TITLE_FUZZY, AUTHOR_SET, NUMERIC_FINGERPRINT, BIBLIOGRAPHY, MANUAL}, score, status ∈ {PROVISIONAL, HUMAN_CONFIRMED, REJECTED}, reviewer, rule_version | — |
| 10 | **EXTRACTION record** (`XTR-`) + **ADJUDICATION** (`ADJ-`) | NEW (Step 09) | PROV Activity/Agent | XTR: doc_id + locator, extractor (model id+version+prompt hash, or human id), blind flag, seen_model_output flag, field values, timestamp, minutes. ADJ: links ≥2 XTR → final OBS, adjudicator, decision per field, timestamp | — |
| 11 | **KINETIC series** (`KIN-` + `KINPT-`) | NEW (Step 09) — SSOT §216.2/§210.29 | — | KIN: kinetic_experiment_id = sexp_id, target, food_matrix, process, initial_conditions, temperature_schedule (T(τ), location), timepoints, observation ids, **author-reported** model family / fitted parameters / units / uncertainty / fit diagnostics (flag `fit_by ∈ {AUTHOR, PROJECT}`), identifiability_status, source, evidence_tier. KINPT: one row per (series, τ, replicate) → OBS id | KIN → ≥2 KINPT |

**Existing method ledger (MEAS-).** Keep it, and extend its v1.1 vocabulary:
- family enum (verified: HPLC, LC_MS, GC_MS, GC_IMS, GC_O, …, CALCULATION, OTHER, UNKNOWN; **no SPME_GC_MS**);
- `extraction_technique`, protocol, calibration, LOD/LOQ per method;
- instrument settings for texture/colour;
- comparability notes.

Method is referenced **per OBS**, because one paper can use HPLC for one analyte and GC-MS for another (`r_evidence_model` Q4).

**Condition profile (COND-).** Keep it. Link per SEXP/SMP, not per paper. Add the 07.B axes: water:food ratio, lid, start mode, geometry class, O2/headspace, tissue vs medium pH, per-axis provenance, condition_grid_id.

**How the current three sources map today (no new values):**
- **USDA R6 (7,018 rows).**
  - SRC (database release) → DOC (local release file sha256) → STUDY (one compilation record, `origin_type = DATABASE_AGGREGATE`).
  - EVD rows = AGGREGATE with `aggregation_method = UNKNOWN` and `method_indicator = IMPUTATION_POSSIBLE_NOT_ROW_IDENTIFIABLE`.
  - Censoring: `censor_kind = GT_CAP` (">100 reported as 100") and `ROUNDED_INTERVAL` (nearest 5%, resolution 5).
  - `member_lineage_status = NOT_IDENTIFIABLE` (manifest DS-001 "no (NOT_IDENTIFIABLE)").
  - `retention_definition = TR_OR_AR_UNDISCLOSED`.
  - `independence_resolution = SOURCE_FAMILY_ONLY`.
  - No SEXP/SMP/OBS.
- **Bognár 2002 (7,090 rows).**
  - SRC (report) → DOC → STUDY compilation (`DATABASE_AGGREGATE`).
  - AGGREGATE, `retention_definition = TRUE`.
  - About 50% of rows have GT_CAP 0.995; the cap justification is UNVERIFIED (05.2).
  - PRIMARY_SOURCE edges only if the report bibliography maps per table (UNVERIFIED; manifest says "no (compiled)").
  - `independence_resolution = SOURCE_FAMILY_ONLY` unless 08.4 finds otherwise.
- **Phenol-Explorer 3.6 (3,870 rows, 125 publications).**
  - SRC (database) + 125 `pe_pub` SRC → STUDY per publication (`PRIMARY_STUDY`, `design = UNKNOWN`).
  - Rows with before/after become, deterministically, one SEXP with two SMPs (REFERENCE_BEFORE, TREATED_AFTER) and OBS for each, plus a DERIVED retention.
  - The retention's parents include the cited yield factor (e.g. `BERGSTROM 1994_GAINS-AND-LOSSES`). That yield publication becomes a STUDY/SRC node.
  - The DRV forces a split-group merge of the two publications.
  - Shared `before` values within a paper/matrix produce `SHARES_REFERENCE_SAMPLE` PROVISIONAL candidates. These matter for Cochrane ch. 23.3.4 shared-control correlation.
  - `independence_resolution = PUBLICATION_ONLY` (study ≠ publication not verified).

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 4. Independence groups

Three nested keys per EVD/OBS row, computed by Step 08 and frozen by Step 15:

1. **`study_id`** — the data-generating campaign (Cochrane "study, not report"). It equals NOT_IDENTIFIABLE for DB aggregates without member lineage. **Never fabricated.**
2. **`lineage_root_id`** — the connected component over STUDY/DOC/AGG nodes using the merging edges {SAME_STUDY_AS, QUOTES_VALUES_FROM, ALTERNATE_OF, REVISION_OF, SHARES_SAMPLES_WITH, PRIMARY_SOURCE when membership is known}. **The statistical independence unit.** Used for:
   - "k independent lineages";
   - consensus/conflict independent-source counts (§257F.7; MP W12 L1892–1915);
   - agreement analysis (SSOT L25309);
   - cluster ids for RVE / three-level models and cluster bootstrap.
3. **`split_group_id`** — lineage components additionally merged by:
   - (a) DERIVED records whose parents span lineages;
   - (b) AGGREGATE rows with `member_lineage_status = NOT_IDENTIFIABLE` (the whole source_family becomes one node);
   - (c) optionally SAME_LAB_AS (the lab-disjoint tier).
   
   **The evaluation unit** for Split 6 (SSOT L16886–16891).

**`independence_resolution`** ∈ {STUDY, PUBLICATION_ONLY, SOURCE_FAMILY_ONLY, UNKNOWN}. It records how fine the grouping really is. **UNKNOWN rows may train but never test.**

**Construction algorithm (deterministic, CPU):**
1. Normalize ids.
2. Detector B0–B3 proposes LIN edges.
3. Apply only merging edge types with status ≠ REJECTED. PROVISIONAL edges merge in the conservative mode.
4. Union-find gives `lineage_root_id`.
5. Add DRV parent unions and source-family nodes; union-find gives `split_group_id`.
6. Emit the registry + component report.

The rule version is hashed. Two rebuilds must be identical.

**Giant-component rule** (from MP AM3 L3610–3613; threshold PROPOSED_PILOT, pre-registered in 08.0). If the largest split group holds >40% of a target family's rows:
- report it;
- evaluate with grouped K-fold over the remaining components + leave-one-source-family-out;
- label the result "publication-component CV", never "study-disjoint".

**Current reality (verified counts):**
- 127 independence groups (USDA 1, Bognár 1, PE 125).
- PE shares 0 targets with USDA/Bognár.
- USDA↔Bognár share 67 (L1) / 249 (L2) cells on 4 ingredients.
- Study-disjoint with ≥10 test clusters is feasible **only for PE polyphenols** (`r_eval_splits` Q3).
- Step 14 coverage targets must therefore be stated in **independent lineage components per cell**, not rows.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 5. Split keys provided by the model (claim → key)

| Split family (brief §33) | Key in this model | Claim it tests | Feasible now |
|---|---|---|---|
| Study-disjoint + publication-disjoint (merged) | `split_group_id` (lineage component) | no lab/study effect drives performance | PE only |
| Lab-disjoint (stricter tier) | `split_group_id` with SAME_LAB_AS | simulator/kinetic transfer across research groups (Step 27) | NEED_DATA (labs not recorded) |
| Source-held-out (evidence plane) | `source_family_id` | cross-database agreement (diagnostic) | diagnostic only (3 sources) |
| Platform-disjoint | `OBS.method_id` → MEAS.family/platform | analytical transfer (volatiles) | NEED_DATA (MEAS 3 rows) |
| Condition-OOD (within-study blocking) | `SEXP.condition_grid_id` + COND levels | kinetic extrapolation (G15-5) | NEED_DATA (no D-C series) |
| Matrix-OOD | SMP matrix facets + ingredient cluster | Step 27 V3 domain mapping | depends on Step 26 system |
| Pair-holdout / ingredient-cluster-disjoint | ingredient_id × process_id (EVD) | compositional / unseen-food generalisation | yes (headline per SSOT L16896–16901) |
| Both-new (S4) | ingredient ∉ train ∧ process ∉ train | abstention stratum | yes, small |

The split registry rule (Step 15) is claim-first: a split without a `claim_id` is not built (`r_eval_splits` R-1). Groups are assigned before any test metric (SSOT §257A.15 L28336–28338). Four partitions are used: train / val / **calibration** / test. Calibration is lineage-disjoint from test (G15-6; SSOT §257G.9 L34854–34862).

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 6. Replicates, uncertainty, censoring, basis

- **Replicates and dispersion.**
  - Store `statistic`, `dispersion_type` + value, `n_biological` and `n_technical`, separately.
  - The log response ratio variance needs mean, dispersion and n for both arms (Hedges et al. 1999; Lajeunesse 2011).
  - If only median/range/IQR are reported, a mean/SD estimate is permitted only as a DERIVED `ESTIMATED_FROM_SUMMARY` record (Wan et al. 2014). It is never MEASURED.
  - All 17,978 current rows are `NOT_REPORTED_BY_SOURCE_ROW` for SD, n and LOD. Inverse-variance weighting is therefore impossible on the current corpus. Downstream must use unweighted or cluster-robust estimators and say so. **Never impute.**
- **Censoring.**
  - `censor_kind` ∈ {LT_LOD, LT_LOQ, ND, GT_CAP, ROUNDED_INTERVAL, RANGE_ONLY, TRUE_ZERO}, with `limit` and `resolution`.
  - Censored values are never targets for log transforms (ES-1.1 rule).
  - Downstream training uses censored or interval likelihoods. The DEL-2 "train at bound 0.975" practice is flagged for Steps 29/30 (SSOT §222.5 L23992–24001; §201.9 L16692–16717).
  - TRUE_ZERO is in SSOT L23973 but missing from the repo registry (verified). Add it via Step 04/07.D.
- **Basis.**
  - Basis is part of the value. Cross-basis pooling is forbidden without a DERIVED conversion that cites its inputs (e.g. moisture), following the FAO/INFOODS unit/denominator conversion guideline.
  - `retention_definition` ∈ {TRUE, APPARENT, YIELD_ADJUSTED, TR_OR_AR_UNDISCLOSED, UNKNOWN} is mandatory (SSOT L16632).
  - Analyte basis (e.g. ascorbic acid vs total AA+DHA) is recorded on OBS.
- **Uncertainty propagation.** DERIVED records carry propagated uncertainty, or UNKNOWN if the inputs lack dispersion. Digitized values carry digitization uncertainty and the DIGITIZED origin. They are never merged with tabular values without a quality flag (§257F.5 L34747–34756).
- **Model-estimated / simulated / imputed values never enter OBS.** They live in MODEL / SIM ledgers with their own tiers (E6/E7/I) and `may_enter_gold_evaluation = false`.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 7. Conflict structure

- **Harmonise first, then conflict** (§257F.7 L34761–34765; SSOT §241.5 workflow via `r_rag_confidence`).
- A CONFLICT record is created **only after** compatibility checks on matrix/cultivar/part/form, process leaf, conditions, basis, analyte basis, platform and lineage.
- **Record:** `conflict_id`, the target cell, supporting OBS/AGG set, opposing set, matched variables, differing conditions/platforms, **independent-source count = # distinct `lineage_root_id` per side**, harmonisation trace and status ∈ {NONE, EXPLAINED_BY_CONDITION, GENUINE, UNRESOLVED}.
- **Never majority-vote rows.** Votes are counted by lineage, and only after harmonisation (MP W12 L1915; SSOT L26355–26368).
- **Ownership.**
  - Step 08 supplies lineage.
  - Step 11/14 create conflict candidates during acquisition.
  - Step 15 freezes the conflict-cluster table.
  - Step 36 renders REPORT_CONFLICT as a status orthogonal to the support rung (`r_rag_confidence`).
  - The existing `registry/evidence/conflict_queue.csv` (16 rows) and EVD `conflict_cluster` are migrated, not discarded.
- **Known current case.** USDA vs Bognár mineral retention for boiled veg/poultry (~0.9 vs ~0.5; S039). This is an UNRESOLVED candidate. Independence is unverified until 08.4.

## 9. Invariants (validator rules to implement in 08/09; tests in `tests/unit/test_lineage_*.py`, `test_extraction_*.py`)

1. Every OBS has exactly one SMP. Every SMP has one SEXP. Every SEXP has one STUDY. Every STUDY has ≥1 DOC, or is a typed compilation record.
2. No `study_id` without a DOC locator. NOT_IDENTIFIABLE carries a reason.
3. AGG is never pooled with its own members. DRV parents are complete, and their groups are merged.
4. No log/ratio is derived from censored inputs. Basis is identical across the parents of a ratio, or a conversion DRV with inputs exists.
5. E4 requires ≥1 human ADJ / verification record with a span match. AI_PRECHECKED ≠ verified.
6. DIGITIZED values carry tool/version/uncertainty.
7. No OBS has `value_origin ∈ {MODEL_ESTIMATED, SIMULATED, IMPUTED}`.
8. Rebuild determinism: the registry hash is identical across two runs.
9. Canonical source rows are byte-identical. All changes are append-only versions.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 10. Residual uncertainty

- **LOW confidence:** the real component structure after linking PE yield sources and DB bibliographies. A giant component is possible. It is cheaper to compute in 08 than to read.
- **UNVERIFIED:**
  - whether USDA R6 and Bognár share primary studies;
  - whether the local Bognár/R6 files carry per-record bibliographies;
  - the cap semantics (05.2);
  - the food-literature duplication rate.
- **PROPOSED_PILOT (not literature constants):** the 40% giant-component threshold, edge-precision LB 0.90, seeded recall 0.95, K = 10 test clusters. Humans pre-register them in 08.0 / 15.
- **SSOT text gaps** (see `ssot_change_requests` in G_B.json):
  - EvidenceAtom.22 `independence_group` is boilerplate (SSOT L31170);
  - §257C has no Study/Experiment/Sample hierarchy;
  - EvidenceAtom lacks basis / n / dispersion / censoring / pairing / extraction_method / licence despite §257A.5 (L28108–28121);
  - the §222.3 status list lacks interval censoring;
  - the G15-H scope for E3 test rows;
  - the G14-6 vacuous pass;
  - the Split 6 unit definition.

---

## 1. Bottom line

1. **Structured open data exist only for endpoints (K0).** These are retention, composition, yields, phenolic retention factors and occurrence tables. The repo already holds the main process-effect ones: 17,978 E3 rows, comprising USDA R6 (7,018), Bognár (7,090) and Phenol-Explorer 3.6 (3,870 rows from 125 papers). Every trajectory/kinetic need for Steps 24–27 and 31–34 is **LITERATURE_ONLY**. All 64 manifest rows say `time_series_available=no` (`registry/data_source_acquisition_manifest.csv`). The census found SOURCE_GAP for 13 of 16 priority cells.
2. **The scarce resource is independent studies, not rows.** Today there are only 127 independence groups: USDA 1, Bognár 1 and Phenol-Explorer 125 (gov §1.1). Every coverage target below is therefore counted in **independent lineage components** (Step 08 `lineage_root_id`) or in **independent lab groups** for kinetic validation.
3. **Acquisition goes deep in one focused system first, then broad.** The recommended first system is ascorbic acid (vitamin C) degradation plus leaching in vegetables at 60–100 °C, with chlorophyll→pheophytin as the pre-registered fallback (r_simulator_vv). The Step-10 extractability census decides between them. Acrylamide/Maillard (the SSOT §210.29A anchors) are deferred to RESEARCH_ONLY extensions, which needs an SSOT change request (PROPOSED_ONLY).
4. **The binding constraints are human verification hours and lawful full text, not discovery or compute** (SSOT §226.11; r_acquisition §2.4).
5. **The schema blocker comes first.** The EVD has no trajectory/KIN table and no SD/n/aggregation-level/LOD fields. Contract addendum 04.K must exist before Step 10. Otherwise any acquired series is flattened to endpoints.

| 36 RAG | bracketing conditions within one study (INTERPOLATE); **genuine conflict** cells; certainty-profile source fields; licence flags | ≥30 bracketed cells; ≥10 genuine conflict clusters after §241.5 harmonisation; labels: ~150–200 hard-negative pairs and ~100 must-abstain questions (Step 36 labels, not acquisition) | r_rag_confidence | 0 | PARTIAL |

**Recipe-demand weighting.** Priority inputs use recipe frequencies computed on **duplicate-group-deduplicated** recipes from 07H-R/07I-R. Food.com is 85% of the base and duplicates would otherwise inflate demand. Mechanical and seasoning events (salt/season 20,293; cream/beat 14,019 recipe support) have no state variable in any ledger, so they go to the declared-gap register, not to acquisition.

## 6. Human-time budget for Phase C (UNVERIFIED; replace with Step-10 timing logs)

| Step | Kush h | Parv h | Expert-domain h | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 12–20 | 10–16 | 4–8 | ~300–400 abstracts double-labelled + 20 dual rows + decision |
| 11 | 40–80 | 30–60 | 10–20 | depends on minutes per row; double extraction ≈ +36% time (Buscemi 2006) |
| 12 | 4–8 | 4–8 | 2 | H2 decisions, audit samples |
| 13 | 6–12 | 6–12 | 0–4 | keys, ≥200 double-labelled abstracts |
| 14 | 40–120 | 40–120 | 10–30 | bounded by stop rules and cost cap |
| 15 | 6–10 | 4–8 | 2–4 | rulings, sign-off, sealing |
| **Total** | **≈110–250** | **≈95–225** | **≈28–68** | an external domain expert is not identified (UNVERIFIED availability) |

**Ways to get more evidence per human hour:**
- Pre-register everything once.
- Double extraction only for test-eligible rows.
- Single extraction plus audit for certified field classes on production rows.
- A random audit stream instead of exhaustive review.
- Stop rules per cell.
- Keep reviewers blind to model output for evaluation rows. This avoids having to redo anchored work later (Choi et al. 2024; Schroeder et al. 2025).

---

## 7. What NOT to promise (explicit non-goals)

- **No kinetic parameters from aggregates.** Arrhenius/k cannot be estimated from R6, Bognár or PE rows that lack T/t (SSOT §211.48 L19782–19793). These rows support endpoint prediction and plausibility envelopes only.
- **No trajectory or kinetic evidence from structured databases**, except ComBase microbial curves (outside the core chemistry scope).
- **No "100k evidence rows" target.** MP AH7 (L2868–2885) and AI5 (L3110) say row count is not success. "The 100k target never means 100k invented completions." Growth to 10k+ / 25k+ / 100k is conditional on evidence that really exists (MP L4833–4835).
- **No study-disjoint claim for USDA or Bognár.** Each is one cluster. Until Phase C adds identifiable studies, the only study-disjoint headline is PE polyphenols (r_eval_splits).
- **No condition-OOD headline beyond the focused system.** pH, aw and moisture are 100% UNKNOWN today. Condition-OOD (G15-5) is NEED_DATA except inside the focused-system kinetic partitions.
- **No volatile/aroma process-effect claims, odour-activity weighting or ingredient-level sensory similarity.** Process-conditioned volatiles are LITERATURE_ONLY. Absolute quantities and thresholds are RARE/COMMERCIAL. Sensory labels are NOT_REALISTIC.
- **No texture, lipid-oxidation or furosine cross-study models.** These are declared gaps: RARE comparability.
- **No measured thermal-property values.** Only MODEL_DERIVED Choi–Okos estimates, labelled as such.
- **No rollout trust horizon (34b) without staged-process data.** These are RARE.
- **No full-text corpus redistribution.** No paywalled TDM, no scraping, no PMC bulk packages (retired Aug 2026). The Semantic Scholar corpus is not stored.
- **No LLM-only (E5) rows in any test or calibration set.** No AI_PRECHECKED counted as verified. No accuracy claim from the 20-row pilot.
- **No acquisition by external services using project data.** No agent-created API keys or registrations with the user's email.
- **Absence claims are search results, not proofs.** For example, "no open compiled kinetic database" means none was found in targeted searches.

---

## 8. Risks specific to acquisition (top 8)

1. **Leaching quota unmet.** AA K2 series with leaching-identifying fields may be too few. Mitigation: pre-registered chlorophyll fallback. Otherwise Step 26 becomes NEED_DATA.
2. **Lawful full-text bottleneck.** Food-engineering journals are largely publisher-hosted. Mitigation: Europe PMC CC-BY, library access for Route A, and metadata-first discovery.
3. **Human-gate integrity.** The history includes identical files and delegated reviews. Mitigation: technical provenance checks on every human file and blind adjudication.
4. **Prolific-lab bias and false independence.** Mitigation: lab-level grouping and numeric-fingerprint duplicate detection.
5. **Licence drift.** For example, FoodAtlas became NC on 2026-10-09, and the OpenAlex metering changed. Mitigation: licence snapshots per document and a manifest re-check at the Step 15 freeze.
6. **Budget/rate limits.** OpenAlex gives $1/day free and Crossref allows concurrency 1–3. Mitigation: a throttled, checkpointed CPU harvester, and paid tiers only by H3 decision. The H3 threshold placeholder is still unfilled.
7. **Plane mixing.** Composition, occurrence or property-model values could be taken as process effects. Mitigation: separate sub-planes and a G12-2 check.
8. **Calendar pressure.** The course presentation is on 25–26 Nov 2026 (gov §7.10). Mitigation: report DEL-1 honestly (≥40 verified rows is the course minimum) and do not lower gates.

# ===== J1_mechanism =====
# PART J (first half): MECHANISM INTELLIGENCE ARCHITECTURE

Owner: drafter G_E. Scope: spine Steps 21–25 and their interfaces to Steps 07, 16–18, 26–27 and 36. Written 2026-10-22, plan only.

- The 36-step step cards are missing (ctx.md L13–14). This architecture is reconstructed from SSOT v15, Master Plan v4.0, the repo, and the research notes `r_mechanism_registry`, `r_simulator_vv`, `r_acquisition` and `r_rag_confidence`.
- Citation formats: SSOT Lnnnnn, MP Lnnnn, repo paths. Numeric thresholds are tagged [PROPOSED-PILOT].

---

## J1.0 Design stance in one paragraph

Mechanism intelligence is **a conservative, evidence-first gate system**. It is not a chemistry simulator and not an ontology project.
- Measured, compatible evidence answers "how much" (DIRECT/INTERPOLATE).
- Mechanisms answer "why this may happen" (SSOT §257O.4 L42670–42673). They are allowed to produce numbers only when a chain of three-valued gates all PASS inside a validated domain.
- Each gate's verdict comes from a small native registry that can be checked by machine. External standards are used for their semantics (SBML Constraints, FSK-ML parameter fields, PMF-ML model tiers, QMRF fit-vs-predictivity, NASA-STD-7009B domains), not as storage formats.
- UNKNOWN is the default, and it is reported as an acquisition target rather than repaired by imputation.

---

## J1.1 The decision chain (brief §20), corrected

### J1.1.1 Verdict on the brief chain
`EVENT → direct deterministic change → candidate effects → mechanism applicability → formula applicability → parameter compatibility → validated domain → SIMULATE/RETRIEVE/QUALITATIVE/UNKNOWN`

The chain is **scientifically appropriate as the gate sequence of the SIMULATE branch** (r_mechanism_registry F6.1, confidence MEDIUM-HIGH). It is **not** sufficient as the whole decision procedure. Six corrections are mandatory:

| # | Correction | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| C1 | **Evidence first.** A compatible E1–E4 measurement pre-empts simulation, which becomes a cross-check only. | SSOT §231.2 C8 "retrieve before predict" (L25207); §215.60 decision hierarchy (L22525–22539); MP cascade (L4751) |
| C2 | **Three-valued gates** {PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN} + reason code + evidence ids. UNKNOWN ⇒ no SIMULATE. | SSOT rule 12 (L18026); law UNKNOWN ≠ 0 |
| C3 | **Decision unit = (entity_version × event × target).** | One boil can be SIMULATE for moisture and UNKNOWN for a volatile |
| C4 | **Competing-mechanism gate** between mechanism and formula applicability. | SSOT §210.18–§210.21 (L18938–19000): a single fitted k can hide leaching + degradation |
| C5 | **Input-observability gate.** No imputed simulator inputs (pH, aw, temperature location, duration). | Law "no scientific value invented"; repo COND has 0% pH/aw/moisture (`reports/step07/step07_report.md` L12–23) |
| C6 | **Calibration domain ≠ validated domain ≠ M&S limits.** | SSOT §223.5 (L24119–24121); NASA-STD-7009B Domain of Validation / M&S Limits (r_simulator_vv Q3); Sahigara 2012 / Baranyi 1996 (r_mechanism_registry F2.2–F2.4) |

Terminal routes: `DIRECT · INTERPOLATE · SIMULATE (= MODEL rung, E7, with propagated uncertainty) · QUALITATIVE · ASK · UNKNOWN (→ ABSTAIN)`.
- The brief's "RETRIEVE" covers DIRECT and INTERPOLATE.
- `CONFLICT` is an **orthogonal flag**, not a route (r_rag_confidence). It forces REPORT_CONFLICT in the Step-36 packet.

### J1.1.2 Gate sequence (owner in brackets)

```
G0  EVIDENCE PRE-CHECK            [36-C8 lookup, stubbed in 23]  exact/near compatible E1–E4 row(s)?
       yes → route DIRECT / INTERPOLATE (G4–G8 still evaluated for MECHANISTIC BACKGROUND + cross-check)
G1  EVENT RESOLUTION              [18]   process leaf/family, tool, medium, modifiers resolved?   UNKNOWN→ASK/UNKNOWN
G2  DIRECT DETERMINISTIC CHANGE   [18]   mass split/merge, geometry/cut-state, location/container, setpoint
                                          (DERIVED_DETERMINISTIC; referenced, never recomputed in 22/23)
G3  CANDIDATE EFFECTS             [22]   EFFSIG → {(mechanism_id, target SVAR, allowed directions)} + missing-input list
G4  MECHANISM APPLICABILITY       [23]   per candidate: preconditions(state) ∧ NECESSARY gates ∧ ¬inhibitors
G5  COMPETING MECHANISMS          [23]   ≥2 PASS|UNKNOWN mechanisms on same target ∧ no joint FORM → no number
G6  FORMULA APPLICABILITY         [24→23] FORM exists ∧ assumptions (Constraint exprs) hold for the query
G7  INPUT OBSERVABILITY           [23]   every FORM input present at required location or with defensible interval
G8  PARAMETER COMPATIBILITY+DOMAIN[25→23] compatible PARAM set ∧ domain location ∈ {VALIDATED, CALIB_ONLY, EXTRAP, PROHIBITED}
G9  ROUTE                         [23 rule; executed by 36 C9/C14]
```

### J1.1.3 Route rule (owned by Step 23, executed by Step 36)

```
if G0 finds compatible DIRECT evidence:          route = DIRECT        (cross_check = SIMULATE if G4–G8 all PASS)
elif G0 finds bracketing/near evidence:          route = INTERPOLATE   (same cross-check rule)
elif all(G4..G8 == PASS) and domain == IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN and not safety_critical:
                                                 route = SIMULATE      (MODEL rung; interval; sim_version; domain flag)
elif all(G4..G8 == PASS) and domain in {IN_CALIBRATION_ONLY, EXTRAPOLATED_WITHIN_LIMITS}:
                                                 route = QUALITATIVE + model_estimate{label=RESEARCH_ONLY|EXTRAPOLATED,
                                                         shown only if Step-36 policy allows, widened interval}
elif G4 == PASS and direction set unambiguous across all PASS/UNKNOWN competitors:
                                                 route = QUALITATIVE   (direction only, §208.4 rung A)
elif missing input is user-observable (lid? cut size? duration?) and VOI>0:
                                                 route = ASK
else:                                            route = UNKNOWN → ABSTAIN
conflict_flag = True if G0 evidence disagrees beyond tolerance after harmonisation (§241.5) or G5 directions disagree
```

**Hard invariant (property-tested, G23-2):** no path from any `UNKNOWN` or `FAIL` in G4–G8 reaches `route = SIMULATE`.

### J1.1.4 Three-valued logic

| Gate type | Input value | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| precondition `p(state)` | state var KNOWN, p true / false | PASS / FAIL |
| precondition | state var UNKNOWN | UNKNOWN |
| NECESSARY axis gate [min,max] | value/interval fully inside / fully outside / straddles | PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN |
| NECESSARY axis gate | axis UNKNOWN (no value, no interval) | UNKNOWN |
| MODULATING axis | any | does not change applicability; adjusts direction/selectivity annotation |
| INHIBITING condition/agent | present / absent / UNKNOWN | FAIL (or downgrade to QUALITATIVE if partial) / PASS / UNKNOWN |
| Conjunction (G4) | any FAIL → FAIL; else any UNKNOWN → UNKNOWN; else PASS | Kleene strong logic |
| Condition values from COND before the Step-07 human audit validly passes | | capped at UNKNOWN for gating (retro-fix 07.x-ME2) |

---

## J1.2 Representing what makes a mechanism act

### J1.2.1 Elements (MECH record; r_mechanism_registry F5.1–F5.4)

| Concept | Representation | Example | Anchor |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Activation conditions** | `condition_gates[]`: {CV axis **with location**, gate_type NECESSARY/MODULATING/INHIBITING, interval {min, opt, max} (nullable), `independence_assumed`, matrix_scope, evidence_ids, status}. This is the cardinal-parameter pattern (Rosso et al. 1995), but stored as **intervals with provenance**, not as universal switches. | alliinase NECESSARY `enzyme_activity_state≠INACTIVATED`; temperature MODULATING (heat before rest inactivates) | SSOT §144.1 "no universal temperature switch" (L8976–8986) |
| **Substrate availability** | precondition `substrate_present(MOL/class)` over SVAR precursor concentration (SVAR-FUT-014, to be activated). UNKNOWN allowed. | acrylamide needs asparagine + reducing sugar | SSOT §213.36 intervention variables (L21106–21124) |
| **Enzyme state** | SVAR `enzyme_activity_state` {ACTIVE, PARTIALLY_INACTIVATED, INACTIVATED, UNKNOWN} (retro-fix 03.x-ME1). MECH.enzyme = {EC, GO MF, Rhea}. | PPO browning requires ACTIVE; blanching sets INACTIVATED | GO:0004097 catechol oxidase (OLS probe) |
| **Compartment / cell disruption** | SVAR `cell_integrity` {INTACT, CUT, CRUSHED_PUREED, UNKNOWN} + `time_since_disruption` | garlic crush/rest | SSOT §144.3 garlic×crush/rest/heat (L8994–9002) |
| **Temperature** | axis CV-005…012 *with location*. Product (core/surface) and setpoint/medium are distinct inputs. Kinetic FORMs declare `required_location`. | SIM-AA-1 needs product T or a declared isothermal-small-piece assumption | MP W2 "oven setpoint ≠ core T" (L1504) |
| **pH** | axis CV-013, tissue vs medium distinguished; never averaged | chlorophyll→pheophytin NECESSARY acidic band (pH UNKNOWN in recipes → ASK/UNKNOWN) | MP L82 "never average pH" |
| **aw / moisture** | axes CV-015/016, with basis; moisture gating only where evidenced | Maillard rate moisture-gated (`§210.15`) | SSOT §210.15 (L18878–18896) |
| **Oxygen** | axis CV-021 O2/headspace + SVAR `oxygen_exposure` (covered/uncovered/sealed) | AA aerobic oxidation; lipid oxidation | r_simulator_vv Q1 (AA aerobic vs anaerobic) |
| **Time** | axis CV-001…004 including trajectory and rest/hold; τ process clock, never L13E historical t | rest time after crushing | SSOT L43001–43008 clock separation (ssot_l13e) |
| **History** | `history_dependence[]` listing required SVARs: cumulative thermal dose Ω (with the Ea reference recorded), prior acid/salt exposure, prior blanching, precursor depletion. Carried by Step 18 state, not recomputed. | pre-blanched vs raw before frying | SSOT §198.4 non-commutativity (L15848–15892); §210.13 Ω (L18838–18854) |
| **Inhibitors / mitigators** | `inhibitors_mitigators[]` with SBO roles (inhibitor SBO:0000020, modifier SBO:0000019) + evidence | acid, chilling, blanching, sulfite, antioxidant, O2 exclusion | SBO (r_mechanism_registry F4.1) |
| **Competing / consecutive pathways** | `competes_with[]` and `consecutive_with[]` sharing a target SVAR; triggers the G5 gate | AA: leaching vs aerobic oxidation vs ascorbate-oxidase loss | SSOT §210.18, §210.21 |
| **Matrix dependence** | `matrix_scope` on every gate and every PARAM; MECH carries no numeric parameters. Lab/model-system scope is flagged `MODEL_SYSTEM`. | Maillard glucose–glycine model system ≠ bread crust | van Boekel 2008; Pin 2004 |
| **Markers** | `markers[]` with `marker_unique=false` default; signatures may never infer a mechanism from a marker alone | HMF, colour, pyrazines, hexanal | SSOT §144.1 frozen caution |
| **Unexplained loss** | `MECH-UNRESOLVED_LOSS` sink: allowed as an explicit "unexplained" bucket, never a discovered species | mass-balance residual | SSOT §213.20 (L20926–20936) |
| **Edge semantics** | `edge_semantics` ∈ {REACTION, TRANSPORT, EQUILIBRIUM, STATISTICAL} | leaching = TRANSPORT | SSOT §213.11 (L20775–20784) |

### J1.2.2 What is deliberately not represented
- No universal rate law per mechanism. Rate laws live on FORM, keyed to matrix and conditions.
- No balanced reactions unless species are known and evidenced (MP W6 L1723; G15-RXN L22402–22410).
- No learned interaction edges renamed as chemistry (SSOT L20802).
- No scalar "applicability score" (SSOT §241.3 L26339–26347).
- No numeric mapping of qualitative heat ("medium heat" stays QUALITATIVE; `registry/recipe_condition_surface_forms_v1.csv`).

---

## J1.3 Minimal registries (v1)

All registries are append-only JSONL with a JSON Schema under `ledgers/schemas/`, minted IDs, the common envelope (`provenance`, `verification`, `version`, `status`; `ledgers/common.py`), and per-field provenance class from the repo's 8-value enum (`registry/provenance_class_registry_v1.csv`).

### J1.3.1 Mapping of brief §21 required fields

| brief §21 field | Where | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| model_id | FORM.form_id | `FORM-` prefix avoids the ML `MODEL-` collision (MP X6 L2028–2046; `ledgers/schemas/MODEL.schema.json`). DECISION needed (H4). |
| mechanism_id | FORM.mechanism_ids[] → MECH | many-to-many (lumped models) |
| equation | FORM.equation {ast, latex} | AST is machine-checkable (dimensional analysis) |
| state variables | FORM.state_variables[] (SVAR + unit) | |
| parameters | FORM.parameter_slots[] → PARAM | slots ≠ values |
| units | slot unit by order (§210.30) + PARAM.unit | kinetic units must be added to UNIT (retro-fix 07.x-ME1) |
| assumptions | FORM.assumptions[] as Constraint expressions | SBML semantics: a violated constraint invalidates the result from that point |
| initial conditions | FORM.initial_conditions_required[] | an UNKNOWN IC fails G7 |
| boundary conditions | FORM.boundary_conditions | transport models only; N/A otherwise |
| matrix scope / condition scope | PARAM.fitted_on (calibration domain); FORM.ms_limits (structural limits) | separate objects |
| parameter source | PARAM.source_locator + origin {AUTHOR_REPORTED, PROJECT_REFIT} | never conflated |
| calibration source | PARAM.fitted_on.study_ids + partition=SIM_CALIBRATION | |
| validation source | VAL records (Step 27) | study-disjoint only |
| identifiability status | FORM.identifiability_status + PARAM.ci_method | §211 profile/bootstrap |
| implementation reference | FORM.implementation {path, code hash} | |
| solver | FORM.solver (KiSAO CURIE, e.g. KISAO:0000019 CVODE, or ANALYTIC) | |
| uncertainty | FORM.uncertainty_representation + PARAM distributions/CI | MC propagation in Step 26 |
| status | FORM.status lifecycle (below) | REPRODUCED gate |

### J1.3.2 MECH (Step 21)
`mechanism_id, label, synonyms[], family, kind, local_process_module, participants[]{id, sbo_role}, enzyme{ec, go, rhea}|null, preconditions[]{svar, predicate}, condition_gates[]{cv, location, gate_type, interval{min,opt,max}, independence_assumed, matrix_scope, evidence_ids, status}, inhibitors_mitigators[]{agent_or_condition, sbo_role, evidence_ids}, competes_with[]{mechanism_id, shared_target}, consecutive_with[], affected_targets[]{svar, effect_type, allowed_directions}, markers[]{mol, marker_unique=false}, history_dependence[], edge_semantics, xrefs[]{curie, relation, verification_status}, evidence_ids[]{id, doc_type: PRIMARY|REVIEW_CONTEXT}, gates_unknown(bool), ai_drafted(bool), provenance_class, verification, version`
- No numeric kinetic fields.
- Seed size is about 20–40 entries.

### J1.3.3 EFFSIG (Step 22)
`signature_id, trigger{proc_id|family, modifiers{intensity, geometry, granularity, medium, endpoint}, tool_or_htm}, required_state_inputs[], required_condition_axes[]{cv, location}, deterministic_change_refs[] (Step-18 operator types), candidate_effects[]{mechanism_id, svar, allowed_directions}, rule_source{mechanism_id, evidence_ids}, provenance_class=MODEL_ESTIMATED, is_evidence=false, version`

### J1.3.4 FORM (Step 24a)
`form_id, version, mechanism_ids[], model_tier{PRIMARY, SECONDARY, TERTIARY}, model_family (§210.27), model_kind{KINETIC, TRANSPORT, PROPERTY_MODEL, COMPOSITE}, equation{ast, latex}, state_variables[], inputs[]{cv, required_location, unit, observability_required}, parameter_slots[]{symbol, unit_by_order, positive, needs_T_ref}, assumptions[] (Constraint exprs), initial_conditions_required[], boundary_conditions|null, effective_or_mechanistic, ms_limits{medium, T_range, pressure, phase, geometry_class}, calibration_domain_ref, validated_domain_ref[], identifiability_status, implementation{path, sha}, solver, uncertainty_representation, context_of_use, model_risk_grade, domain_of_verification, credibility_levels, status, source_refs[], licence`

**Lifecycle**:
```
CANDIDATE → REIMPLEMENTED → REPRODUCED → CALIBRATED → VALIDATED_HELD_OUT
                                        ↘ RESEARCH_ONLY        (Step 27 fail)
          ↘ QUALITATIVE_ONLY  (no K≥1 support)      → RETIRED
```
- REPRODUCED means the reimplementation reproduces ≥1 figure or table of its source (BioModels-curation analogue; r_mechanism_registry F1.4). This is **verification, not validation**.

### J1.3.5 PARAM (Step 24b)
`param_id, form_id, symbol_source, symbol_canonical, conversion_note, value|interval|distribution, unit, reaction_order, T_ref, estimation_method, ci{lo, hi, level}, ci_method{HESSIAN, CLUSTER_BOOTSTRAP, PROFILE, POSTERIOR}, correlation_with[], fitted_on{study_ids, lineage_root_id, split_group_id, matrix{ing_id, foodon, class}, composition{moisture, pH, fat, precursor...}, process, design_points[{T_K, t_list}], K_level, measurement{meas_id, basis, analyte}}, fit_T_range, fit_t_range, origin{AUTHOR_REPORTED, PROJECT_REFIT}, effective_or_mechanistic, source_locator{doi, table|figure|page, data_origin{TABLE, TEXT, FIGURE_DIGITISED, SUPPLEMENT}, digitisation_uncertainty}, extraction_tier, verification, partition{SIM_CALIBRATION, SIM_VALIDATION_LOCKED, DOWNSTREAM_TRAIN}`

Rules:
- No PARAM from K0 aggregates (SSOT §211.48 L19782–19793).
- No cross-order unit harmonisation (§210.30 L19164–19187).
- No cross-study pooling without a hierarchical fit (§211.38 L19669–19683).

### J1.3.6 VAL (schema in 24a; rows written in Step 27)
`val_id, form_id, param_set_ids[], eval_series_ids[], study_disjoint{bool, lineage_proof}, matrix_relation{SAME, SAME_CLASS, DIFFERENT}, tier{V1_IN_DOMAIN, V2_HELDOUT_T, V3_HELDOUT_MATRIX}, condition_points[], metrics{ln_ret_err, rmse_natural, bias_factor, accuracy_factor, cov80, cov95, width, crps, vv20_E_vs_uval}, verdict, may_define_validated_domain(bool; V3=false)`

- Bias/accuracy factors follow Ross 1996.
- Comparison error follows V&V 20 (r_simulator_vv Q3).
- **Fit statistics never appear in VAL** (QMRF v1.2 split of Principle 4 vs external predictivity; r_mechanism_registry F3.1).

### J1.3.7 APPDEC (Steps 23 + 25)
`appdec_id, query{entity_version_id, event_id, target_svar, condition_vector_ref, state_ref}, gates{G0..G8: {verdict PASS|FAIL|UNKNOWN|N_A, reason_codes[], evidence_ids[], missing_inputs[]}}, param_subrecord{filters_applied, candidates[{param_ids, match_vector, excluded_reason}], domain_flag, chosen{single|ensemble|conflict}}, route, conflict_flag, ask_candidates[], registry_versions{MECH, EFFSIG, FORM, PARAM, VAL, COND}, created_by_code_sha`

- Replayable and deterministic.
- `is_evidence=false`.
- Persisted batch outputs live in `exports/appdec/` with a manifest. Runtime records are session logs (Step 36).

### J1.3.8 Plane separation
| Registry | Plane | Can enter evaluation sets? |
|---|---|---|
| MECH, EFFSIG | knowledge/model memory (curated) | No (not evidence). MECH evidence_ids point into the evidence plane. |
| FORM, PARAM | model memory (PARAM values are cited facts, but they are *parameters*, not measurements) | PARAM never used as a target label |
| VAL | evaluation records | Is evaluation; built only from E1–E4 held-out series |
| APPDEC | decision logs | No |
| SIM outputs (Step 26, `simulated_state_changes_schema_v1.csv`) | simulation memory, E7 | Never (`may_enter_gold_evaluation=false`; SSOT §223.14) |

## J1.4 Parameter-compatibility retrieval (Step 25, inside the 24 package)

### J1.4.1 Algorithm
```
INPUT  q = (form_id | mechanism_id+target, matrix/entity state, condition vector with locations,
            process history, measurement basis, K requirement)
STAGE 1  HARD FILTERS (never relaxed; each failure → excluded_reason)
   same model_family & reaction_order · unit-dimension consistency (§210.30) · mechanism or declared lumped scope
   · effective_or_mechanistic compatible (§211.40) · T_ref present if reference-T Arrhenius (§210.29A)
   · symbol conversion via explicit table (§263.1) · PARAM.partition ≠ SIM_VALIDATION_LOCKED (during calibration)
   · K_level ≥ K2 if temperature extrapolation is needed (§210.28)
STAGE 2  CATEGORICAL MATCH VECTOR (SSOT §241.3; no scalar before this)
   m_matrix ∈ {EXACT, SAME_SPECIES_CULTIVAR, SAME_FOOD_GROUP, MODEL_SYSTEM, GENERIC}
   m_composition ∈ {INSIDE_FITTED, OUTSIDE, UNKNOWN}        (moisture, aw, pH, fat, precursor)
   m_condition   ∈ {IN_MCP, IN_BOX_ONLY, OUTSIDE, UNKNOWN} + kNN distance (normalised 1/T, ln t, …)
   m_history     ∈ {MATCH, MISMATCH, UNKNOWN}               (raw/blanched, cut state, enzyme state)
   m_measurement ∈ {SAME_BASIS, CONVERTIBLE, INCOMPATIBLE, UNKNOWN}  (AA vs AA+DHA; wet/dry; HPLC vs titration)
   m_design      = K0..K4
   RANK: lexicographic by declared policy registry/mechanisms/param_compat_axis_priority_v1.csv
         (matrix > design > condition > history > measurement)   — a policy, not learned weights
   UNKNOWN on a query axis can only lower the tier, never count as a match (parameter semantics; contrast
   evidence retrieval where UNKNOWN ≠ mismatch, §231.2 C7)
STAGE 3  DOMAIN LOCATION
   IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN       if q inside region covered by VAL(may_define_validated_domain=true)
   IN_CALIBRATION_ONLY        if inside PARAM.fitted_on MCP and kNN ≤ pre-declared quantile
   EXTRAPOLATED_WITHIN_LIMITS if outside calibration but inside FORM.ms_limits
   SIM_PROHIBITED             if outside ms_limits (e.g. >100 °C water system, oil medium, dry heat for SIM-AA-1)
STAGE 4  MULTIPLICITY
   dedup by Step-08 lineage_root_id (re-reports count once)
   1 independent set → SINGLE; ≥2 consistent → ENSEMBLE (spread) or hierarchical PARAM if 26a fitted one;
   ≥2 inconsistent beyond declared tolerance → CONFLICT (lineage ids attached)
OUTPUT   APPDEC.param_subrecord; NO_COMPATIBLE_SET if Stage 1/2 leave nothing usable → G8 = FAIL → no SIMULATE
```

### J1.4.2 Why rule-first and not dense retrieval
- Compatibility is an experimental-design relation. SABIO-RK keys each entry to "one single reaction in one organism under specific experimental conditions" (Wittig et al. 2018, via r_mechanism_registry F5.2).
- Semantic similarity ≠ experimental compatibility (SSOT L25157).
- In the repo, topical rerankers *hurt* evidence retrieval: bge-reranker-large ΔMRR −0.056 [−0.091, −0.017] (`reports/del4/retrieval_silver_v1.md`, via r_rag_confidence).
- A learned ranker is deferred until ≥ a few hundred human-labelled (query, parameter-set) pairs exist.

### J1.4.3 Domain representation
- **Box baseline.** It cannot see empty corners or correlations (Sahigara et al. 2012).
- **MCP** of design points, the predictive-microbiology standard (Baranyi et al. 1996; Le Marc et al. 2005). It is computed in normalised (1/T_K, ln t, other declared axes) space, plus a kNN distance threshold at a pre-declared within-design quantile.
- **KDE dissimilarity** (Schultz et al. 2025, npj Comput Mater 11:95) is an optional later arm.
- **Risk:** with 3–5 temperatures the MCP may collapse to a near-box (U2). E24-2/E25-2 measure this. If B2 does not beat B1, keep B1.

These are listed in full in the structured return.
1. **Domains.** Define calibration domain, validated domain and M&S limits as distinct objects, and derive the validated domain only from study-disjoint VAL records (SSOT §223.5 L24119–24121 uses "validated domain" undefined; the §210.29 schema has no domain field).
2. **Unified kinetic contract.** Unify the kinetic-parameter and reaction contracts: union of §210.29 (L19111–19136), §211.50 (L19806–19827), §216.2 (L22800–22823), §216.3 (L22825–22845) and §213.42 (L21171–21187), plus K-level, T_ref, fit ranges, origin, partition.
3. **Applicability in the decision hierarchy.** Make "mechanism/formula/parameter applicability UNKNOWN ⇒ no MODEL rung" and the competing-mechanism rule explicit in the §215.60 decision hierarchy (L22525–22539) and G16-TRANS, rather than implicit via rule 12.
4. **Reference only, owned by the Phase-F drafter.** The first-anchor choice in §210.29A (acrylamide/Maillard) vs SIM-AA-1.

## J1.9 Residual uncertainty and the cheapest next evidence
- **U1.** Field reporting rates (T_ref, CI, temperature location, aw/pH, raw series) in AA/chlorophyll papers. This decides AA vs CHL and the PARAM volume. Resolved by the Step-10/11 extractability census (2–3 human-days) plus a 1–2 person-day registry pilot: 3–5 MECH, 2–3 FORM, 10–30 PARAM, about 50 compatibility queries. **Running the pilot is now cheaper than more reading** (stop rule §8.5).
- **U2.** MCP vs box with sparse designs. Measured in the pilot.
- **U3.** False-activation tolerance. A human value judgement; pre-register it.
- **U4.** Licences for BioModels content, RXNO/SBO, and digitised figure data. These are H2 items.
- **U5.** Domain-expert availability for MECH and case adjudication. A HUMAN gate.

## J2.0 Starting position (verified)

- **No simulator, kinetic, parameter, formula-model or validation artifact exists.**
  - There is no `src/culinarystate/simulation|kinetics` package.
  - There is no SIM/KINETIC/PARAM/VAL schema among the 37 in `ledgers/schemas/`.
  - `MODEL.schema.json` is an ML model card.
  - The only contract is `registry/simulated_state_changes_schema_v1.csv`. It defines E7 SIMULATED rows with `may_enter_gold_evaluation=false` and a `validation_scope` "against E1-E4 data".
- **No usable trajectory data.**
  - No source among the 64 in the manifest has time series (D-019 SOURCE_GAP).
  - EVD holds 17,978 active rows. All are E3 endpoint aggregates, and none is human-verified.
- **The vitamin C evidence is thin.** It is 423 active rows: USDA 270 on SVAR-000009 and Bognár 153 on SVAR-000215.
  - None of these rows has both temperature and duration measured.
  - Study identity is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE for all of them.
  - **Correction:** earlier notes said 1,196 rows; that figure counted version lines.
  - These rows can serve as a labelled plausibility envelope only. They are neither calibration nor validation data.
  - SSOT L19782–19792 says aggregate RF data cannot give Arrhenius parameters.
- **Phenol-Explorer is not a substitute.** It has 152 K1-like series, but they are polyphenol series dominated by storage studies: only 5 boil groups and 8 K2-like groups from 2 studies (r_simulator_vv §0).
- **Consequence.** Every simulator candidate depends on K1/K2 series acquired from the literature in Steps 09–14 and frozen in Step 15.

### Recommendation and rationale (confidence MEDIUM–HIGH)

**SIM-AA-1 is the recommended first simulator**, with **SIM-CHL-1** as the pre-registered fallback. They are selected under the brief §22 criteria:
- the data exist (largest pool);
- the equation is established;
- parameters are obtainable per matrix class;
- validation is possible across independent labs;
- the system teaches the domain-of-validity and leaching lessons.

They are not selected for impressiveness. Acrylamide was deliberately deferred because it is high-consequence and precursor-dependent.

**The final choice is not made by more reading.** A Step 10/11 extractability census of 50–80 candidate AA and CHL papers (~2–3 human-days) settles it under the pre-registered quotas in J2.2.

**Change request.** The choice departs from SSOT §210.29A / §226.5, which name acrylamide and Maillard as the anchor simulators. A change request is filed with status PROPOSED_ONLY.

### Model structure (SIM-AA-1)

- **State.** C is AA in tissue; W is AA mass in cooking water; D is the degraded amount.
- **Degradation.** dC/dt = −k_d(T_p)·C, with k_d = k_ref·exp[−Ea/R·(1/T_p − 1/T_ref)]. T is in kelvin (SSOT L19146–19160, L18759–18763).
- **Leaching.** A lumped term −k_L·(C − C_w/K_p), where k_L depends on the piece-size class. It is OFF for steam, sealed or no-water media (SSOT §210.21 L18987–19000; compartment rather than PDE, §213.25–27 L20988–21004).
- **Product temperature.** By default T_p equals the bath temperature, within a declared piece-size limit. A lumped-capacitance option is available but flagged EXTRAPOLATED until validated.
- **Solver.** An analytic piecewise solution plus an ODE solver, with the KiSAO ID recorded.
- **Invariants.** Mass balance and non-negativity. The semigroup property holds by construction (SSOT L20537–20549).
- **Output basis.** Explicit: reduced AA, or AA+DHA only if a DHA pathway is calibrated.
- **Model-form choice.** First-order is the default. Weibull is used only if first-order fails held-out checks inside SIM-CAL (SSOT L19042; L22130–22140).

No food-specific V&V standard exists. The adopted stack is below (HIGH confidence on structure; r_simulator_vv Q3).

| Layer | Standard / source | What we adopt | Where |

| Vocabulary and levels | NASA-STD-7009B (2024-03-05) [V] | Domain of Verification; Domain of Validation ("region enclosing all sets of M&S inputs for which the M&S responses compare favorably with the referent"); M&S Limits; validation-factor levels (Table 9); use-assessment levels (Table 15: within domain of validation / within domain of verification / within M&S limits); capability vs results credibility factors. **Exact rubric text is to be transcribed at Step 24. Level semantics beyond the r_simulator_vv summary are UNVERIFIED.** | 24 (fields), 26e, 27h |

| Validity guard | SBML L3 Constraint semantics [V] | Assumptions stored as constraint expressions; results invalid from the point of violation | 26e |
| Food kinetics practice | Dolan & Mishra 2013 [V-meta]; van Boekel 2008 [V] | Scaled sensitivity coefficients; optimal design; limits of elementary kinetics in food matrices | 26a/26c |
| Statistical calibration | Kennedy & O'Hagan 2001 [V-meta] | Explicit model-discrepancy term, used as an interval option in 27 and as the basis of the hybrid in Step 33 | 27, 33 |

**Pipeline.**
1. Code verification (26c): analytic vs numeric, convergence, mass balance, units, invariants.
2. Solution verification: time-step study.
3. Synthetic truth recovery (26c; SSOT §273.2 logic).
4. Reproduction of the source-paper fits (REPRODUCED status; 24/26).
5. Calibration on SIM-CAL (26d).
6. Validation on the SIM-VAL lockbox (27).
7. Credibility and use assessment (27h).
8. Release decision: domain-scoped VALIDATED_HELD_OUT, or RESEARCH_ONLY.

## J2.4 Held-out validation design

- **Unit of independence.** The lab or research group, via the Step 08 `lineage_root_id` / `split_group_id`, including parameter re-reporting edges. Papers are not the unit, because labs publish many papers on one system.
- **Partitions.** Frozen in Step 15 before any fit, separately for AA and CHL:
  - SIM-CAL is about 50% of groups and must be a subset of DS-TRAIN;
  - SIM-VAL is about 30% and is a read-locked lockbox;
  - DS-TEST is about 20% and is the Step 30/33 headline test.
  - DS-TEST ∩ SIM-CAL = ∅.
  - DS-TEST ∩ SIM-VAL = ∅ by default. Overlap is allowed only as a declared sensitivity analysis when there are fewer than ~12 groups.
- **Tiers.**
  - HV-1: in-domain held-out groups. This tier is gated.
  - HV-2: a held-out temperature band. Reported; G15-5 candidate evidence for Step 33.
  - HV-3: a held-out matrix class. Used for domain mapping only.
  - HV-L: leaching module, on mass-balance or open-vs-sealed series only.
- **Blind protocol.** Inputs are limited to t0 state and conditions. Applicability (APPDEC) runs first, and SIM_PROHIBITED queries count as abstentions. There is one confirmatory run per pre-registration, with a hash-chained access log. Any change made after the lockbox is opened makes the result exploratory.
- **Baselines on identical queries.**
  - S27-B0: persistence.
  - S27-B1: E3 process-mean retention.
  - S27-B2: pooled empirical log-linear.
  - S27-B3: nearest compatible evidence.
  - S27-B4: regularised linear or GBM on (T, t, matrix class, medium).
  - S27-B2 to B4 are trained on SIM-CAL only.
- **Negative controls.**
  - NC-1: wrong-matrix parameters.
  - NC-2: shuffled temperature.
  - NC-3: degradation-only on boiling.
  - NC-4: randomized literature-prior parameters.
- **Statistics** (r_eval_splits).
  - Paired cluster bootstrap over lab groups, or a cluster sign-flip permutation when there are fewer than ~20 groups.
  - Holm correction across the confirmatory comparisons.
  - No fold-SE confidence intervals.
  - Per-cluster tables.
- **Pass gate** (PROPOSED_PILOT values, frozen in `reports/step27/preregistration_v1.md`):
  - beat S27-B1 and S27-B3 on HV-1, with the CI excluding 0;
  - 90% predictive-interval coverage on HV-1 in [0.80, 0.97], with no cluster below 0.60 unless flagged;
  - no significant residual trend with T;
  - controls NC-1, NC-2 and NC-4 are worse than the simulator;
  - at least 5 validation groups, otherwise the result is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY;
  - the leaching term is validated on HV-L, or the context of use is restricted to steam/sealed cooking;
  - G15-H, G15-R and G15-8 hold.
- **E3 envelope.** Bognár boil (24 rows) and steam (23 rows) categories, compared on the same basis. Reported only, labelled NOT_VALIDATION, and never gated.

## J2.5 Uncertainty propagation

Sources, propagated by plain Monte Carlo with 10³–10⁴ draws (CPU-trivial):
1. **Parameters.** Joint posterior or cluster bootstrap of (ln k_ref, Ea, k_L), in the reference-T parameterisation.
   - The model is hierarchical within a matrix class, with study offsets (SSOT §211.21 L19476–19496).
   - One-step global fitting is preferred over two-stage fitting (SSOT L19318–19341; Giannakourou & Taoukis 2021 §7 [V]).
2. **Inputs.** Product vs bath temperature, time, water ratio, piece size and initial concentration.
   - Intervals are used only when the source or user gives one.
   - **An UNKNOWN input is never defaulted. It triggers a prohibition.**
3. **Model form.** From HV-1 residuals (Oberkampf–Roy), or a Kennedy–O'Hagan discrepancy term. The term is widened for calls flagged EXTRAPOLATED_WITHIN_LIMITS (SSOT L19606–19616).
4. **Measurement.** Analytical basis and method error at study level.
5. **Censoring.** A censored likelihood for timepoints that are not detected or below LOD (SSOT L19291–19316). Censored values are never substituted with fixed values (SSOT L23961–23964).

**Outputs.**
- A predictive interval for ln(C/C0), and for water-phase AA, at the requested times.
- Parameter uncertainty and predictive uncertainty are reported separately (SSOT L19590–19604).
- Each output carries a domain flag and the sim_version.
- No scalar "confidence" is produced (brief §28).

## J2.6 Domain-of-validity representation

There are four distinct regions, stored per output variable in the model card and in VAL- records:
- **Domain of verification.** Inputs over which the code was verified (26c).
- **Calibration domain.** The SIM-CAL design points, plus their minimum convex polyhedron (MCP) or convex hull, plus a kNN-distance radius.
  - A per-axis box is kept only as a summary. A box cannot detect empty regions or correlations (Sahigara 2012; Baranyi 1996; Le Marc 2005; r_mechanism_registry Q2, HIGH).
- **Domain of validation.** HV-1 and HV-L design points that passed, in the same MCP + kNN form. It is set only from VAL- records with `may_define_validated_domain=true`, and never from calibration.
- **M&S limits.** Hard structural assumptions:
  - temperature ≤ 100 °C at ambient pressure;
  - water or steam media only;
  - piece-size class within the declared limit;
  - no oil, dry heat or microwave unless product temperature is measured;
  - matrix classes with a compatible PARAM set only.

**Axes.**
- Categorical: matrix class, medium, process family, piece-size class, start mode, lid.
- Continuous: T, t, water:food ratio, and pH and O2 where calibrated.
- Categorical axes must match exactly. Continuous axes go through the MCP + kNN test.

**Per-call flag** (enum added to the Step 04 contract):
- **IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN.** May appear as a Step 36 MODEL rung estimate with its interval and sim_version.
- **EXTRAPOLATED_WITHIN_LIMITS.** May be shown only with that label and widened intervals, and only if the context-of-use risk permits. Otherwise suppressed.
- **SIM_PROHIBITED.** Routes to RETRIEVE, QUALITATIVE, ASK or ABSTAIN.
- **NOT_VALIDATED.** The state before Step 27, or under RESEARCH_ONLY. Research reports only.

**Residual risk (U2).** With typical designs of 3–5 temperatures × 4–6 times, the MCP may collapse to near-box or degenerate shapes. If so, E26-5 falls back to box + kNN and records the limitation.

## J2.7 Prohibition rules (SIM_PROHIBITED → retrieve / qualitative / ask / abstain)

Simulation is prohibited when any of the following holds:
1. Step 23 applicability is UNKNOWN or NOT_APPLICABLE, or a competing mechanism dominates without a jointly fitted model. Examples: ascorbate-oxidase loss in raw or cut tissue below the inactivation temperature; dry-heat roasting or frying.
2. A required input is UNKNOWN and has no defensible interval. This is the input-observability gate (r_mechanism_registry Q6).
3. The request is outside the M&S limits.
4. Step 25 returns NO_COMPATIBLE_SET, for example a matrix class with no calibrated analogue. There are no cross-matrix defaults.
5. The output would serve as evidence, as an evaluation or calibration label, or as Gold. This rule is frozen (SSOT L24247–24255; MP L595; permanent law "simulation ≠ measured evidence").
6. The claim is safety-critical. None applies to AA. It would apply to acrylamide.
7. The simulator's `validation_status` is not VALIDATED_HELD_OUT and the request comes from a user-facing path (Step 36).
8. A direct compatible E1–E4 measurement exists. **DIRECT and INTERPOLATE pre-empt MODEL** (Master Plan L4751 cascade; r_mechanism_registry Q6).

**Step 36 cascade:** DIRECT → INTERPOLATE → MODEL (IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN only) → QUALITATIVE → ASK → ABSTAIN. A conflict between the simulator and direct evidence is reported as REPORT_CONFLICT. The simulator never overrides evidence.

## J2.8 E7 synthetic-prior rules (never in final real evaluation)

1. **Namespace.** Use TIER-E7 (provenance_class SIMULATED). This avoids collisions with the L12 encoder rung E7, L13E Phase E7 and the MP E0–E14 labels.
   - The SSOT tier ladder (§201.7, E1–E6) has no E7, so a crosswalk change request is filed.
2. **Origin.** E7 is generated only from a sim_version with `validation_status = VALIDATED_HELD_OUT`. Otherwise generation is restricted to identifiability, design and method-benchmark uses, which carry no pretraining or performance claims.
3. **Per-row provenance.** Mandatory fields:
   - sim_model_id, sim_version, param_draw_id or seed, randomisation_spec_id;
   - domain_flag, one of {IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN, EXTRAPOLATED_WITHIN_LIMITS, RANDOMIZED_BEYOND_LIMITS};
   - validation_status;
   - simulator_family = FOOD_PROCESS_KINETIC and clock = PROCESS_TIME, never mixed with L13E cultural simulators;
   - generated_for;
   - may_enter_gold_evaluation, may_enter_calibration and may_enter_evidence, all = false.
4. **Plane separation.** E7 is stored in `ledgers/sim/DATA-SIM_v1/`. It never goes into EVD or DATA-EVIDENCE, and never into a Step 36 citation. A CI firewall test fails the build if any SIM id appears in a test, calibration or Gold manifest.
5. **Hard prohibition.** Frozen in SSOT §223.14 (L24247–24255): synthetic or imputed target rows never enter final test or calibration sets. The headline test is always real and study-disjoint (L24209–24213).
6. **Uses, in priority order** (SSOT §223.4 L24109–24117; §274.5 L44385–44394):
   1. identifiability and optimal-design targets for Step 14 (§224.4);
   2. Step 34 rollout stress tests, kept separate from real evaluation (L20441–20445);
   3. method benchmarks, e.g. SINDy/CRNN recovery (§213.43A), RESEARCH_ONLY;
   4. pretraining only as a gated ablation in Step 30/33.
7. **Mandatory controls whenever E7 trains anything** (C-1…C-8, all executed in 30/33):
   - C-1: ratio sweep 0/0.25/0.5/1/2/5×, reporting every ratio (L24188–24203);
   - C-2: real-n learning curve;
   - C-3: TRTR / TSTR / mixed;
   - C-4: matched-volume randomized or wrong-physics simulator control (the §274.2 analogue for L15; SSOT change request);
   - C-5: calibration-leakage partition algebra (SIM-CAL ⊆ DS-TRAIN; DS-TEST ∩ SIM-CAL = ∅);
   - C-6: memorisation, two-sample and physics checks (L24215–24223);
   - C-7: E7 condition span ⊇ real training span (Read et al. 2019 [V-meta]);
   - C-8: calibration damage, with PROPOSED_PILOT thresholds: real-only 90% coverage drop > 0.03 absolute, or interval-width increase > 20%, counts as "unacceptable" under G15-10.
8. **Promotion.** Pretraining is retained only if the real-only study-disjoint benefit survives the ratio sweep, beats C-4 and passes C-8 (SSOT §227.11; G15-10 L22391).
   - Otherwise the real-only model is retained, and the negative result is recorded (§215.69).
   - There is one pre-registered evaluation per system, with no post-hoc ratio search.
9. **Generators.** Statistical or LLM target generators stay LOW priority and are not used for targets (L24173–24186). A custom kinetic PFN is a stretch goal only (L24450–24456).
10. **Default.** Step 28 is DEFERRED until Step 27 passes. Hierarchical Bayesian priors from 26d already fill the "prior" role (§226.2 L24485–24517).

  - 26a, the kinetic fitting and identifiability library, moves forward from Step 32 and is shared with it. The numbering is unchanged.

## K.1 Data regime: what the transition models actually see

| Quantity (verified read-only) | Value | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| ACTIVE EVD rows | 17,978. All tier E3, all DATABASE_AGGREGATE or PE per-paper aggregate. 0 human-verified | Only D-A/K0 claims are possible (SSOT L15657, L19782–19792) |
| Independence groups | 127 (USDA 1, Bognár 1, PE 125 publications) | Study-disjoint is possible only for PE. Nutrient "study-disjoint" is impossible until Steps 10–14 |
| Independent matrix×process units (TB L10) | USDA 171, Bognár 123, PE 287 | n_eff ≈ 10²; models with >~10² effective parameters per source are variance-dominated on cold splits |
| Censored rows | 5,894, all GT_CAP (USDA "100"→97.5; Bognár "1.00"→0.995). LOD null everywhere | Right-censoring dominates; left-censoring (ND/LOD) does not exist yet |
| Measured conditions | USDA T measured 0 rows; Bognár t measured 0 rows; PE both 1,561 rows; moisture/pH 0%; location-valid T 213 | The C mode of Y[I×P×C×J] is practically empty (ssot_sparsity §1.11) |
| Time series | ~152 PE pseudo-series from 26 publications, mostly storage. ≥3 temperatures: 29 series from 3 publications (r_transition_ml) or 8 groups from 2 studies (r_simulator_vv); the two counts use different definitions and are UNVERIFIED as reconciled. No vitamin C, chlorophyll, acrylamide, HMF or starch series | Arrhenius is not identifiable from EVD (D-C ≈ 0) |
| True intermediate states | 0. Composite multi-step rows: USDA 1,429, PE 195 | Rollout R2+ is NEED_DATA. Only a composition test is possible |
| Density | Definition-dependent: 0.33% F×P×T over all sources (ssot_sparsity DIAG); DEL-2 grids USDA 0.0755, Bognár 0.621, PE 0.00267 | A canonical cell definition must be frozen before any density claim (MP AM1; SSOT L23422) |
| MNAR | DEL-2 propensity AUC 0.81–0.91 (marginal-frequency model) | Strong structured missingness. Evaluation under random masking is optimistic |

**Regime rule.** D-A (aggregates), D-B (raw-vs-processed panels; none in repo), D-C (focused kinetics; none in repo) and D-D (recipe procedure; 612,782 recipes, no measured chemistry) are separate strata. They are never pooled as exchangeable (SSOT L23463; §215.3 L21998–22009). Each row carries `data_regime` and `K_rung` (look-ahead to Steps 03/05/15). The SSOT activation rule "dataset supervision ⇒ eligible model family" (L22017–22025) decides which rungs run on which stratum.
