## N.1 Laws applied (non-negotiable; brief §3; SSOT §230 invariants L25147–25170)

| Law | How the architecture enforces it |
|---|---|
| UNKNOWN ≠ 0 | Every axis has explicit UNKNOWN states; UNKNOWN is never coerced and always lands in KNOWN UNKNOWNS |
| Model memory ≠ evidence memory | Packet sections are typed by plane; MODEL/SIM blocks can never fill DIRECT/INTERPOLATE |
| Simulation ≠ measured | Separate SIMULATION plane; simulator output only IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN, labelled "model estimate" |
| Recipe procedure ≠ chemistry truth | Recipe-plane facts are DIRECT FACTS about *what the recipe says*, never chemistry evidence (inv. #6; SSOT L26288) |
| Structural ≠ sensory | FlavorTwin evidence classes; sensory wording blocked without sensory evidence (SSOT L26304, L26767–26774) |
| Silver ≠ Gold; synthetic/imputed never in final eval | Benchmark/calibration partitions exclude silver/templated/simulated/AI-assisted items (inv. #14–#16) |
| Complexity must beat simple baselines | SSOT ladder B0–B7 + 9 ablations; promotion by paired cluster bootstrap with margin |
| No invented values | Output precision ≤ evidence precision (SSOT L26425–26431); 0 uncited numbers enforced by template/enforcer |
| No post-hoc gate weakening | All G36-* thresholds pre-registered before locked access; locked set sealed with access log |

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## N.2 Query parsing (C1 intent/slots; C2 entity link; C5 goals/constraints)

- **Input:** the raw query plus the session state reference. The raw query is preserved (SSOT L25198).
- **Intent:** multi-label over the D-008 task types (PROPOSED REVISED list):
  - T1 CURRENT_STATE · T2 NEXT_ACTION · T3 TRANSFORMATION_EXPLANATION · T4 PROCESS_SUBSTITUTION · T5 ADAPTATION · T6 MISTAKE_RECOVERY · T7 PROCESS_COMPARISON · T8 CHEMISTRY_RELEVANCE.
  - Evidence regimes (DIRECT/NEAR/UNSUPPORTED/CONFLICT/AMBIGUOUS) are slices, not intents.
  - An OOD-intent class routes to ABSTAIN (out of scope).
- **Slots:** each slot carries a raw span, a parsed value, a calibrated confidence (D8) and `status ∈ {RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS(candidates), UNRESOLVED, NOT_GIVEN}`.
  - food/matrix (ING id + facets: variety, part, form/cut, maturity);
  - prior state;
  - process leaf + family;
  - target (SVAR canonical id; equivalence status from `registry/svar_duplicate_mapping_v1.csv`);
  - conditions (T with location, t, medium, pH, aw/moisture, geometry);
  - measurement basis wanted (e.g. per raw vs per cooked weight);
  - quantity (CQPO tuple);
  - goal direction (maximise/minimise/compare);
  - constraints.
- **Linking** uses the frozen BGE linker (S128; Acc@1 0.881 on 850 gold, pre-adjudication κ 0.317). No safe autonomous NIL exists, so UNRESOLVED stays UNRESOLVED (SSOT L25199 "do not force unresolved pronouns").
- **Rule:** slot ambiguity is never resolved silently. Ambiguous slots are candidates for ASK (§N.13), and the cascade is re-run per candidate value to compute VOI.
- **Known risk:** on templates, slot accuracy was 0.945–0.994. Target accuracy was 20.5% before a lexicon fix (WORKLOG S071 L493). Real questions will degrade parsing. This is exactly where the BM25/dense fallback (L3/L4) earns its place, and why G36-RET is evaluated with **predicted** slots.

## N.3 Current state and history (C3, C4, C18)

- **State source:** the event-sourced state graph G_t (SSOT §233 L25327–25396). Steps 16–18 own EVT/ENTITY/STATE; the ledgers have 0 rows today.
- **State fields:** each is a belief tuple (value/interval, unit, provenance class, timestamp, evidence/model ref, uncertainty) (L25338–25345). The STATE schema has belief ∈ {PREDICTED, OBSERVED, PLANNED}.
- **History** H_t is the ordered event list. Event order is immutable except by adjudication (C4).
- **Observation override (C18):** a direct current observation overrides an older prediction on *observable* fields. The old prediction stays in the audit trail (L25347; SVAR `observable_in_session`).
- **Packet linkage:** every packet carries `current_state_version` (hash of the replayed graph prefix), which is §257M mandatory.
- **Prototype limitation:** compiler vs Gold state-field accuracy is about 0.10–0.14 (`reports/del3/compiler_vs_gold_v1.md`). So state-dependent answers (B4) must carry D8 = LOW until Steps 16–19 improve it, and B4 vs B3 (RQ16-01, EXP-000007) is the test of whether state helps at all.

## N.4 Constraints (C5, C11)

- **Hard constraints come first** (tools, medium, time, allergens/diet, process prerequisites, irreversibility). Utility comes after (SSOT §243.3 L26462). Soft preferences come after hard constraints.
- **Allergen/diet constraints** only from authority tables: FSSAI/FSIS (MP L615, L3270) with human-ticked ALLERGEN→ING links. FlavorDB is never an allergen authority.
- **"Do not invent priorities"** (C5). When objectives conflict (e.g. browning vs nutrient retention), return Pareto alternatives (C15; §243.5).
- **Rejections** use the 15-code registry (§257A.12 L28265–28283), e.g. MISSING_TOOL, INCOMPATIBLE_STATE, NO_EVIDENCE, MODEL_NOT_VALIDATED, IRREVERSIBLE_STATE.

## N.5 The planes it reads (and what may never cross)

Six planes (brief §13; SSOT §232.3 L25268–25272 planes; §233.7 L25387–25396 memory classes). SIMULATION is kept separate per §232.3 (change request F-6).

| Plane | Ledgers/artifacts | Feeds packet section | Never allowed to feed |
|---|---|---|---|
| SOURCE memory | REC, recipe_base (immutable), SRC/SNAP, raw spans | DIRECT FACTS (what the source says), CITATION MAP | chemistry claims (inv. #6) |
| RECIPE SEMANTIC memory | ING/ALIAS/PROC/TOOL/UNIT/QNT/POR, recipe identity (07I/07I-C) | CURRENT STATE context, FEASIBLE ACTIONS (process ontology), dedup | DIRECT EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE |
| SCIENTIFIC EVIDENCE memory | EVD/COND/SVAR/MEAS/STUDY + Step-08 lineage; DATA-EVIDENCE v1 | DIRECT EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE, NEAR/INTERPOLATION, CONFLICTING EVIDENCE | — (only E1–E4 for evaluation; E3 labelled DATABASE_AGGREGATE) |
| STATE / EPISODE memory | EVT/ENTITY/STATE/GRAPH, session observations | CURRENT STATE, HISTORY | evidence plane (an observation in a session is not a study) |
| MODEL memory | Step 29–33 transition models (whitelisted), calibrators, mechanism applicability (APPDEC-) | MODEL ESTIMATES (model sub-block), MECHANISTIC BACKGROUND (qualitative) | DIRECT/INTERPOLATE; Gold/test labels |
| SIMULATION memory | Step 26–27 SIM outputs (E7) with sim_version + validation status | MODEL ESTIMATES (simulation sub-block, IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN only) | DIRECT/INTERPOLATE; test/calibration; Step-28 E7 prior never surfaced as an answer |

Further forbidden flows:
- LLM parametric knowledge is never evidence (SSOT L28104).
- Historical or synthetic-history rows never enter EVD (SSOT L44383).
- Imputed/simulated values cannot masquerade as direct evidence (SSOT L26444).

## N.6 Retrieval layers and when each helps

Order follows SSOT §241.1 (R1–R8). Each layer has a decision attached.

| Layer | Decision | When it helps | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| L1 structured slot→key lookup over (matrix id, process leaf/family, target SVAR, basis) | **PRIMARY** | every process-effect/state query where slots resolve | silver MRR 0.856 oracle; HARD AUROC 0.975 predicted slots |
| L2 hierarchy expansion (food CHILD/PARENT/ANCESTOR; process SAME_FAMILY) | KEEP, vertical only | no exact row (coverage 7.1%→20.3%) | siblings hurt (+0.036 MAE) |
| L3 BM25 over evidence atoms (+ captions/footnotes once Step 09 provides them) | KEEP as fallback + baseline | free text; cultivar/compound names; unlinked rows (6,409 rows lack ingredient_id); slot-parse failure | BEIR robust baseline; silver 0.597 |
| L4 dense (e5-large-v2), fused with L3 by RRF (k=60) | KEEP as fallback; **never blended into L1 ranking** | paraphrase / free-text; predicted-slot failure | RRF 0.762; +0.005 n.s. over L1 |
| R5 generic cross-encoder | **DROP** (negative result kept; control in RQ16-03) | — | −0.056 / −0.091 MRR; topicality ≠ cell compatibility |
| R5′ compatibility classifier (structured vector + categorical match types; optional text features), trained on **scientific hard negatives** | CANDIDATE | ranking within the compatible pool; P(support) feature for D7 | promote only if it beats L1-with-predicted-slots on human pairs, food/process/source-cold (RQ16-03; SSOT L26825) |
| R6 condition-compatible filter (§N.7) | KEEP, extend | always, after candidate generation | SSOT §241.3 |
| R7 lineage dedup + §241.5 conflict harmonisation (§N.10) | KEEP, replace direction-only detector | always | SSOT L25309, L26353–26367 |
| Late interaction (ColBERTv2) | DEFER | only if Step 13 builds a ≥10^6-passage runtime full-text index | BEIR cost/benefit |
| GraphRAG community summaries / LLM-built KG | REJECT as evidence | (possible later corpus-overview analytics only) | model-written text in the evidence plane |
| SciFact/MultiVerS-style claim verifier | Step 09 (extraction), not runtime | runtime only if Step 13 passages are served | Wadden 2020/2022 |
| Historical-context retrieval (E13E-18) | DEFER (36-H) | after G13E-01/02 pass on a dated corpus | `research/r_l13e_identity.md` |

Further rules:
- **Rank weights** (0.35/0.65, ×0.3) may stay as a ranking heuristic, but **must not feed confidence**. The D7 retrieval domain uses a calibrated P(support) from R5′ when promoted; otherwise it is a raw feature explicitly marked "not a probability".
- **Query playbooks** (SSOT §257O L42635–42704):
  - quantity lookups bypass dense RAG entirely (SSOT L25282);
  - mechanism lookups answer "why may this happen", never "how much" (L42670–42673);
  - diagnosis and recovery use separate indexes (L42674–42694).
- **Tried-query logging:** every retrieval call logs the queries tried, so that failure-to-find is reproducible (MP W10 L1854) and feeds Step 14.

## N.7 Condition-compatible filtering (C7)

**Canonical 13-axis compatibility vector.** It merges SSOT §241.3 (10 axes, L26344), MP AO2 (12 axes, L3716–3727) and the repo's 9 axes. Spec file: `registry/rag/compatibility_axes_v1.csv`.

| # | Axis | Match types / values |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | matrix: food id, species, food group, part, cultivar | EXACT · CHILD · PARENT/ANCESTOR · SAME_SPECIES · SAME_FOOD_GROUP · GROUP_ROW ("vegetables, such as…") · SIBLING · UNLINKED · UNKNOWN |
| 2 | state/form/cut (prior state; raw vs processed) | EXACT · COMPATIBLE · MISMATCH · UNKNOWN |
| 3 | process | leaf EXACT · STEP (multi-step contains) · SAME_FAMILY · GENERIC_MECHANISM · MISMATCH |
| 4 | temperature (value + location: setpoint/medium/surface/core) | EXACT · BRACKETED (query between two measured levels of one study/group) · NEAR(Δ) · MISMATCH · UNKNOWN_QUERY · UNKNOWN_ROW |
| 5 | time | as axis 4, with log-ratio distance |
| 6 | medium / heat-transfer mode | EXACT · COMPATIBLE · MISMATCH · UNKNOWN |
| 7 | pH | as axis 4 (100% UNKNOWN today) |
| 8 | aw / moisture (+ WET/DRY basis) | as axis 4 (100% UNKNOWN today) |
| 9 | geometry / size | EXACT · NEAR · UNKNOWN |
| 10 | target (SVAR canonical; equivalence status) | EXACT · EQUIVALENT_CANDIDATE (flagged) · SAME_CLASS · MISMATCH |
| 11 | measurement basis (fresh/dry weight; per raw/per cooked; %TR vs %AR; yield-corrected "apparent" retention) | COMPATIBLE · CONVERTIBLE (with DRV inputs) · INCOMPATIBLE · UNKNOWN |
| 12 | measurement method/platform | SAME · DIFFERENT · UNKNOWN (MEAS has 3 rows; PE method null) |
| 13 | source/tier/verification (quality, reported for D1, not a match) | tier, provenance class, verification status |

Rules:
1. **Hard exclusion from DIRECT** on a MISMATCH of axis 1 (SIBLING/UNLINKED), axis 3 (other family), axis 10, or axis 11 (INCOMPATIBLE). Hard mismatches leave candidates in the *rejected candidates* audit list with reasons; they are not deleted.
2. **UNKNOWN is neutral but never silent.** An UNKNOWN on either side does not exclude a row (SSOT L25206), but it is listed in KNOWN UNKNOWNS and lowers D3.
3. **Censoring-aware.** GT_CAP / LT_STATED / ROUNDED_INTERVAL rows are compared as intervals and reported as intervals. There are no midpoints and no clipping (D-013; MP AM2 "do not clip RF>1").
4. **Basis rule.** No cross-basis pooling. Conversion is allowed only through a deterministic DRV record with its inputs (e.g. moisture); otherwise the axis is INCOMPATIBLE (MP-1 L38–43).
5. **Bracketing detection** (axes 4, 5, 7, 8) requires ≥2 measured levels *from the same study/lineage component*, with the query level strictly between them. This is the entry predicate of INTERPOLATE (§N.13).
6. **Categorical match types are kept** in the packet. Any learned scalar is only a ranking aid (SSOT L26347).

## N.8 Scientific hard negatives (for RQ16-03, the RET benchmark and P1 stratification)

SSOT §241.4 (L26349–26352) lists five types:
1. same food, wrong process;
2. same process, wrong time/temperature;
3. same target, related food;
4. raw vs processed mismatch;
5. wrong analytical endpoint.

Data-driven additions from this ledger (`research/r_rag_confidence.md` §3.1):

6. same cell, different **basis** (fresh vs dry; per raw vs per cooked);
7. reported retention factor that is yield-corrected ("apparent") vs a concentration ratio (ES-1.1 conflict C4);
8. same analyte under a duplicate/equivalent SVAR id;
9. censored GT_CAP row vs a measured row;
10. source-side-imputed (USDA `SOURCE_SIDE_IMPUTATION_POSSIBLE_NOT_ROW_IDENTIFIABLE`) vs measured;
11. sibling food with the asked target;
12. **lineage duplicate** (the same primary data republished in two databases looks like replication);
13. group row ("vegetables, such as …").

Each type is a stratum. Report per-type AUROC/Recall, not only pooled. Steps 10–14 should deliberately capture instances of types 1–5 and 12 (SSOT L26351; `notes/ssot_l16.md` §10).

## N.9 Reranking

- The generic cross-encoder is a control only.
- Within the compatible pool, ordering is by reasoning role and compatibility tier: EXACT > BRACKETED > NEAR(vertical) > QUALITATIVE. Ties break by D1 quality then by independence.
- A learned R5′ is a candidate (§N.6). Its headroom is small (silver HARD AUROC 0.975 with predicted slots), so it is a *small* model (logistic/GBDT over the categorical vector) and is promoted only on human labels.

## N.10 Lineage dedup and conflict harmonisation (R7)

1. **Collapse lineage duplicates before any agreement analysis** (SSOT L25309):
   - evidence rows by Step 08 `split_group_id` / `lineage_root_id` (`research/r_evidence_model.md`);
   - recipe copies by 07I-C OP-SPLIT groups ("5 copies ≠ 5 sources").
   - Report `n_independent_groups`, `n_lineage_collapsed`, and the share of support from a single database (D6).
2. **SSOT §241.5 harmonise-first workflow** (L26353–26367), applied before declaring a conflict:
   1. units/metric;
   2. food/cultivar/matrix;
   3. state/form;
   4. process leaf/family;
   5. conditions;
   6. analytical platform;
   7. lineage/independence;
   8. tier/quality.
3. **Output:** a conflict cluster with `conflict_status ∈ {NONE, EXPLAINED_BY_CONDITION, GENUINE, UNRESOLVED}` and a **harmonisation trace** recording which check explained the disagreement. Consensus labels follow MP W12 (CONSENSUS_SUPPORTED / CONDITIONALLY_SUPPORTED / MIXED/CONFLICTING / SINGLE_SOURCE / INSUFFICIENT / UNKNOWN; MP L1906–1913).
4. **No LLM majority vote or debate** (SSOT L42208–42218; MP L1915). GENUINE/UNRESOLVED conflict among comparable rows sets the REPORT_CONFLICT flag (§N.13).
5. **Data reality:** genuine conflicts are probably rare after harmonisation (UNKNOWN base rate). Seeds are the 17 `conflict_queue.csv` rows and the USDA↔Bognár boiled-vegetable/poultry mineral disagreement (~0.9 vs ~0.5; WORKLOG S039). Whether USDA R6 and Bognár share primary studies is UNVERIFIED, and Step 08 must settle it before cross-source agreement is called independent.

## N.11 Evidence packet v2 (brief §27 + justified additions)

Schema: `ledgers/schemas/PKT.schema.json` (PROPOSED; H4). It is compiled by reasoning role, not retriever rank (SSOT L26368).

### N.11.1 Header (SSOT §257M mandatory L42164ff, plus versioning)
- `packet_id`, `packet_schema_version`, `query_id`, `session_id`, `current_state_version`;
- `evidence_snapshot_hash` (ES-1.1 export / DATA-EVIDENCE v1);
- module versions: parser, linker, retriever, compatibility spec, calibrators, model ids;
- `response_mode` (ANSWER/COMPARE/ASK/DIAGNOSE/RECOVER/RECOMMEND/ABSTAIN), `response_rung`, `conflict_status`;
- `sufficiency_mode` + machine-readable reasons;
- `output_precision_cap`;
- `evidence_class` summary.

### N.11.2 The 15 brief §27 sections (= SSOT §232.5 L25289–25304)

| Section | Content / rule |
|---|---|
| QUERY | raw + parsed slots with status/confidence |
| CURRENT STATE | belief fields with provenance; observable vs inferred |
| HISTORY | ordered events (C4) relevant to the query |
| GOAL | parsed objective(s); no invented priorities |
| CONSTRAINTS | hard/soft; authority-backed allergens |
| DIRECT FACTS | source-plane facts (what the recipe/user/authority states) and deterministic derivations (unit conversion, Q0) |
| DIRECT EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE | compatible rows (EXACT cell) with conditions, tier, independence count, value as reported (+ censoring, basis) |
| NEAR / INTERPOLATION EVIDENCE | BRACKETED rows (same study/group) and vertical-relative rows, each with distance and the indirectness flag |
| MECHANISTIC BACKGROUND | Step 21–23 mechanism applicability (APPDEC-) and review literature: **qualitative only**, never a number for the asked condition |
| MODEL ESTIMATES | sub-blocks MODEL (whitelisted L15) and SIMULATION (Step 27 IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN): estimate, interval, coverage level, calibration split id, training-support summary, OOD/evidence distance, model/sim version |
| CONFLICTING EVIDENCE | conflict clusters + harmonisation trace + independence groups |
| KNOWN UNKNOWNS | every UNKNOWN axis/slot/field with reason code |
| FEASIBLE ACTIONS / HYPOTHESES | §257A.11 candidate-action records (18 fields) after C11; diagnosis hypotheses with verifier status |
| DISALLOWED CLAIMS | §257A.13 generated list (e.g. no exact pH; no model value called measured; no structural = sensory; no causality from cross-study association; no review cited as primary when the primary is available) |
| CITATION MAP | claim slot → evidence/source ids → locators (table/row/col/span) |

### N.11.3 Additions (with justification)

| Added field | Justification |
|---|---|
| CONDITION DIFFERENCES | MP AO1 L3702. Makes condition distance explicit (§257M.2 "preserve condition distance") |
| CERTAINTY PROFILE (D1–D10, per outcome cell) | SSOT §242.1 vector made operational; GRADE per-outcome domains (§N.12) |
| EVIDENCE STATUS (unsupported / physically_possible / evidence_supported) | SSOT §49.x: status ≠ confidence, reported separately (`research/r_rag_confidence.md` §0.1); MP-1 frozen output contract |
| REJECTED / EXCLUDED CANDIDATES (+ reason) | audit trail for hard mismatches and lineage duplicates; makes over-filtering (RQ16-06 risk) measurable |
| INDEPENDENCE SUMMARY | n studies / lineage components / duplicates collapsed / single-DB share (D6); required by §257M.5 "independence groups" |
| ASSUMPTIONS / CONVERSIONS | unit/basis conversions, alias mappings, SVAR equivalences used. Required so precision caps and basis rules are auditable |
| APPLICABILITY | Step 23 status and Step 27 domain flag. UNKNOWN ⇒ MODEL rung forbidden (`research/r_mechanism_registry.md` Q6) |
| ANSWERABILITY | missing/ambiguous slots, VOI estimate, the candidate clarification question with options (§257M.10 L42263–42273) |
| CLAIM LEDGER pointer (RCL) | claim_id → evidence ids/model output → claim_route → allowed precision. Feeds UCR and citation metrics (G16-PROV) |
| SAFETY / WARNINGS (separate) | authority-only safety content kept apart from evidence (MP I5 L645 "no warning without evidence") |
| LICENCE FLAGS per cited source | RESTRICTED (A1 BBC) local-only; PE redistribution permission; NC sources (SSOT §250) |
| RETRIEVAL TRACE | layer that produced each item; queries tried (MP W10). Makes failure-to-find reproducible and feeds Step 14 |
| RECOVERABILITY (diagnose/recover modes) | REVERSIBLE … UNKNOWN (SSOT L26479); recovery evidence separate from cause evidence |
| WHAT WOULD CHANGE THIS ANSWER | the discriminating observation/measurement. Links ASK/OBSERVE/MEASURE (§243.8) and Step-14 acquisition |

**Per-item fields:**
- row id, source id, locator/rationale span;
- independence group and lineage-collapsed ids;
- the 13-axis compatibility vector with categorical types and numeric distances;
- D1–D6 domain levels;
- censoring/basis/imputation flags;
- value as reported + unit + reported precision (never more decimals than the source).

**Context ordering for any LLM rephrase:** decisive items first and last (Liu et al., TACL 2024, "Lost in the Middle"). The deterministic template (B5T) is primary, and the LLM may only rephrase under the enforcer.

## N.12 Non-scalar confidence: the certainty profile (per query × outcome cell)

Each domain is an ordinal level {HIGH, MODERATE, LOW, VERY_LOW, UNKNOWN} plus raw features. **Domains are never multiplied or summed** (SSOT L26381; §49.x "do not multiply arbitrary confidence values"). UNKNOWN is never coerced. The 13 SSOT q-dimensions (L26384) map into these domains. Spec: `registry/rag/certainty_profile_spec_v1.csv`.

| Domain | GRADE analogue | Raw features | Source step | SSOT q-dims |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 source / design quality | risk of bias | tier; design_strength; provenance_class; verification_status (UNVERIFIED/AI_PRECHECKED/HUMAN_VERIFIED/ADJUDICATED); source-side imputation flag; DIGITIZED flag; review-vs-primary | 05, 08, 09, 15 | q_source |
| D2 extraction correctness | — | P(row correct) from the Step-09 audit stratum; verifier label SUPPORTS/REFUTES/NEI + locator | 09 | q_extraction |
| D3 indirectness / condition compatibility | indirectness | 13-axis vector, categorical types, numeric distances, bracketing flag, # UNKNOWN axes | 07, 15, 36A | q_condition, q_process, q_target |
| D4 inconsistency / conflict | inconsistency | conflict_status + trace; dispersion of log-retention across independence groups (only if ≥3 groups) | 15, 36A | q_agreement |
| D5 imprecision | imprecision | n, SD/SE/range (none today), censoring kind/limit, LOD/LOQ status, source rounding (e.g. USDA nearest 5%), interval width | 09, 12, 15 | q_measurement |
| D6 independence / concentration | publication bias (adapted) | # independence groups, # studies, # collapsed duplicates, single-DB share | 08, 15 | (new) |
| D7 retrieval relevance | — | calibrated P(support) (R5′) or raw rank (flagged "not a probability"); producing layer | 36C | q_retrieval |
| D8 parse / link / state | — | slot confidences; linker confidence; quantity Q-level; state-reconstruction confidence | NER block, 16–20 | q_entity, q_quantity, q_state |
| D9 model uncertainty | — | conformal/CQR interval at a stated level; calibration split id; model version; gate passed | 29–33, 27 | q_model |
| D10 applicability / OOD | — | distance to the nearest training/evidence cell; validated-domain flag; mechanism applicability status | 23, 27, 30 | q_OOD |

**Per-decision calibrated probabilities** (SSOT §242.2 L26387–26398) are small **logistic/Platt** models over 1–6 profile features, one per decision:
- P(direct answer correct);
- P(claim supported);
- P(abstain is right);
- P(link correct), only if not already calibrated in the NER block.

Interval coverage uses conformal methods rather than a probability. These calibrators set rung thresholds. The *profile* is what the user and evaluator see. Isotonic calibration is forbidden below ~1,000 labels per decision (scikit-learn docs; change request F-2).

## N.13 Support cascade, ASK, conflict and precision cap (C14 + policy)

Evaluation runs top-down. The **first** rung whose entry predicate holds **and** whose calibrated selective threshold is met wins. The canonical enum crosswalk is in `registry/rag/support_class_crosswalk_v1.csv`; see change request F-1.

| Rung | Entry predicate (all required) | Precision cap | Disallowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| **DIRECT** | ≥1 non-conflicted row with axis 1 EXACT, axis 3 EXACT/STEP, axis 10 EXACT, axis 11 COMPATIBLE; condition axes EXACT or UNKNOWN (UNKNOWN listed); D2 ≠ REFUTES | value/range as reported, with conditions and independence count; never more decimals than the source | universalising beyond the reported conditions (§257M.1) |
| **INTERPOLATE** | (I-cond) same cell, query condition BRACKETED by ≥2 measured levels from one study/lineage component, monotonicity not contradicted; **or** (I-hier) axis 1 CHILD/PARENT with other axes as DIRECT, *only if* hierarchy-relative use is validated on human labels in 36C (silver promotion alone is insufficient) | interval spanning the bracketing/relative values; no curve fit unless a Step 24 model is validated | point value; extrapolation outside the bracket; sibling foods |
| **MODEL** | (target, domain) ∈ `l15_fallback_whitelist_v1.csv` (G15 decision record) **or** simulator IN_VALIDATION_DOMAIN (Step 27); D10 in-domain; Step 23 applicability ≠ UNKNOWN; interval with stated coverage on the matching split | interval + "model estimate" label + coverage statement with split; never "studies show" (§257M.3) | model value as evidence; any number when OOD |
| **QUALITATIVE** | broad/near evidence consistent in direction (vertical relatives, process family, unlinked-food rows) **or** mechanism APPLICABLE (Step 23) | direction/ordinal only | any number for the asked condition |
| **ASK** (pre-emptive) | a missing/ambiguous slot whose candidate values change the winning rung or the answer (cascade re-run per candidate value ⇒ VOI > 0, SSOT §243.8 L26481–26491); query cost acceptable | one discriminating question with options + conditional answers (§257M.10) | asking when all values give the same answer (NeverAsk/AskAll/VOIAsk test) |
| **ABSTAIN** | none of the above; or OOD without qualitative support; or out of scope/safety-critical without authority | known unknowns + what evidence would be needed | any factual process-effect claim |

Placement and override rules:
- **ASK placement.** ASK is evaluated *before* any rung that the missing slot would degrade, as the repo policy already does for CRITICAL_SLOT_MISSING. The brief's linear order DIRECT → INTERPOLATE → MODEL → QUALITATIVE → ASK → ABSTAIN is kept as the precedence of the *fallback path*. The two are reconciled by VOI pre-emption.
- **CONFLICT.** Conflict is not a rung. It is D4. When `conflict_status ∈ {GENUINE, UNRESOLVED}` among comparable rows, the response mode carries **REPORT_CONFLICT** at the highest rung where comparable evidence exists. It reports both sides with conditions and independence and does not average them (§257M.5). If the conflict leaves nothing informative, the system goes to ABSTAIN.
- **Precision cap** = min(rung cap, evidence precision, D5-implied precision) (SSOT §242.7). Back-off follows conformal factuality (Mohri & Hashimoto, ICML 2024): numeric → interval → ordinal → qualitative.

**Thresholds.** For each rung:
1. Choose the threshold on its calibrated probability so that the upper 95% Clopper–Pearson bound of empirical selective risk on the **calibration partition** is ≤ α_rung (Geifman & El-Yaniv 2017 style). Alternatively, use conformal risk control with UCR as the loss.
2. Claim guarantees **only** on the exchangeable (random) split. Cold/shifted splits are reported empirically (Tibshirani et al. 2019; Ovadia et al. 2019).

**Feasibility arithmetic** (two-sided 95% CP bound, computed here):
- n=60, 0 errors → ≤6.0%;
- n=104, 5 errors → ≤10.9%;
- n=240, 12 errors → ≤8.6%;
- n=320, 16 errors → ≤8.0%.

So per-rung α=5% statements need several hundred calibration labels per rung. Until then, α_rung is set at PROPOSED_PILOT 0.10–0.15 and labelled as such.

## N.14 Decision policy (C10–C15; SSOT §243)

**Order:**
1. C13 relevance gate ("relevance is not causality");
2. intent → mode;
3. critical-slot/VOI check (ASK);
4. C11 feasibility (hard constraints before utility);
5. evidence cascade per candidate (C8/C9);
6. precision cap;
7. C12 comparator (median per independence group, existing) → C15 Pareto set (no global utility);
8. C16 generation;
9. C17 claim ledger;
10. C18 session update.

**Modes:**
- **ANSWER / QUALITATIVE answer** (§257A.10).
- **COMPARE.** Evidence-only counterfactual A vs B. This is inverse-design rung I0 (§214.7) and is allowed without G15-INV.
- **RECOMMEND.** "Recommend one supported step → observe → update" (receding horizon, §243.10 L26499–26505). There is no whole-recipe planning (anti-creep, §257A L28480–28491).
- **DIAGNOSE.** Proposer→verifier against symptoms, history and missing discriminators (§243.6). Cause language stays qualified.
- **RECOVER.** Recovery evidence is separate from cause evidence (§243.7). Recoverability enum. Only if failure/recovery gold exists for evaluation (RQ16-18/19); otherwise the modes run unevaluated and are not claimed.
- **ASK / OBSERVE / MEASURE.**
- **ABSTAIN.**

**Candidate records:** the §257A.11 18-field schema, evidence class per §214.30 (OBSERVED/INTERPOLATED/MODEL-ESTIMATED/EXTRAPOLATED/UNSUPPORTED). EXTRAPOLATED is never surfaced with a number. "Practical POMDP" only (§243.11): state estimate + uncertainty + VOI + short horizon. No RL.

## N.15 Grounded generation and claim ledger (C16, C17)

- **Primary generator:** the deterministic template B5T (promoted on silver: 0 unsupported, 0 mode violations).
- **Optional:** local-LLM rephrase under the post-hoc enforcer (B5F+E). It is unpromoted, and promoted only if it improves a human-rated quality metric without raising UCR or cap violations. Local models only; no external API with project data.
- **Claim-language templates** come from `claim_route` (§257A.14 L28298–28324): EXPLICIT/MEASURED, EXTERNAL_VERIFIED (database/study reports; semantics fixed in Step 04), INTERPOLATED, MODEL_ESTIMATED, IMPUTED (never surfaced as a value), SIMULATED, CONFLICTING, UNKNOWN.
- **Runtime claim ledger RCL** (PROPOSED prefix; it avoids the collision with research CLM):
  - fields: claim_id, response_id, packet_id, claim_text, claim_type, claim_route, evidence_ids, model_id/version, allowed_precision, citation_refs, disallowed_claim_checks, conflict_ids, verification_status;
  - this is the union of SSOT §238 ClaimLedger (L26054–26064), MP AO3 (L3736–3745) and the annexA additions.
- **Checks:** numeric claims are verified exactly (value + row id). Qualitative claims are verified by NLI/human. Silent class upgrades count as 0-tolerance failures.

## N.17 Evaluation

**Benchmark design** (36B):
- Task types D-008 T1–T8 × evidence regimes (DIRECT/NEAR/UNSUPPORTED/CONFLICT/AMBIGUOUS).
- Registry fields (MP AI6 L3170–3180): task type, difficulty, source family, ingredient/process family, evidence regime, answer kind, must-abstain, gold evidence, constraints.
- Plus `split_group_id`, `evidence_cell_id`, `curator_id`, `seen_system_output`.

**Partitions** (SSOT §257A.15 L28336, four partitions):
- dev;
- calibration (P1 pairs + P2 questions + calibration items; lineage-disjoint from test);
- locked test.

Train is not applicable: the system is rule-based plus small calibrators.

**Sizes:**
- target 320 = 80 dev + 240 locked; stretch 440 (MP AH5 L2834–2850);
- **≥240 locked is the minimum for any paired 10 pp claim** (McNemar ≈155–233 items);
- 104 = descriptive only;
- the achieved tier is always reported.

**Strata/splits:**
- random (the only stratum for guarantee claims);
- food-cold, process-cold;
- both-new (abstention stratum);
- lineage-component-disjoint (Step 08; PE-only today);
- support-regime held-out (RQ16-06);

The benchmark's relation to the training/tuning of other components is documented (`research/r_eval_splits.md` §4).

**Ladder** (SSOT §245.12 exactly):
- B0 LLM-only → B1 dense → B2 BM25+dense RRF → B3 structured → B4 state-aware → B5 state + compatibility/conflict packet → B6 + whitelisted L15 → B7 + calibrated recommend/ask/abstain.
- The MP AI9 variant is retired (it moves calibrated abstention into B5).
- Week-6-style rule: "B5 must earn itself" (MP L3282) generalised to each rung.

**Ablations, oracles and robustness:**
- the 9 SSOT ablations (L26684–26692), plus hierarchy, dense fallback, ASK, calibrator and template-vs-LLM ablations;
- oracle vs predicted upstream for slots, state and evidence (L26698; MP AW9);
- robustness (L26702–26709).

**Metrics:** as in the Step-36 card (§A METRICS). Headlines:
- condition-compatible Recall@10 (retrieval);
- UCR (grounding);
- AURC at matched coverage (selective answering);
- mode macro-F1 with asymmetric cost (decision).

**Statistics** (`research/r_eval_splits.md` Q5):
- pre-registered primary metric × split per claim;
- paired cluster bootstrap (B ≥ 10,000) over clusters = recipe SPLIT_GROUP / evidence cell / authoring session;
- cluster sign-flip permutation if fewer than ~20–30 clusters;
- margin δ promotion;
- Holm (confirmatory) / BH (exploratory);
- sealed locked test with access log;
- n_clusters reported beside every number.

```
Step 15 + 08 + 09 + 19(DG-2) + 36A + 36B ─► 36C selective RAG: human retrieval ladder, RQ16-03, sufficiency,
                                          Platt calibrators, cascade+VOI ASK, whitelist-gated MODEL rung,

                                          (36C.9 historical RAG = DEFERRED)
Step 35 + 36C ──────────────────────► 36D.1 static FlavorTwin
Steps 11–14 volatiles OR 27/33 ─────► 36D.2 process-conditioned FlavorTwin (NEED_DATA)
G15-INV / G15-12 ───────────────────► 36D.3 inverse design I1+ (I0 COMPARE already in 36C)

```

Critical-path observation: Step 36's critical path is **human labels**, not compute or architecture. The chain is D-008 → P1/P2 → independent Deep Gold DG-2 (Step 19) → locked authoring. Starting 36B early is the single largest schedule lever for this phase.

## N.19 FlavorTwin boundary (summary; full in Part O)

- **Consumes from the shared core:** canonical foods, quantities, state graph, process ontology, evidence ledger, transition engine (whitelisted), uncertainty/OOD, provenance (SSOT §246.9).
- **Step 35 typed similarity registry:** STRUCTURAL, CHEMICAL, COMPOSITIONAL, SENSORY, FUNCTIONAL, NUTRITIONAL, CULTURAL, PROCEDURAL and PROCESS-CONDITIONED notions, each with its own null model and evaluation set.
- **Candidate** = ingredient + state + process + conditions. Each candidate carries per-notion components and a §246.6 evidence class. There is no universal scalar.
- **Sensory:** ingredient-level sensory similarity is UNSUPPORTED (no labels).
- **Process-conditioned flavour** is NEED_DATA (no volatiles in EVD).
- **Mandatory baselines:** §246.8 plus LLM zero-shot/RAG and GISMo/LLM substitution.
- **Pairing statements:** frequency-preserving/Curveball nulls (Jain, Rakhi & Bagler 2015 PLoS One; `research/r_l13e_identity.md`).
- **Novelty claim** (MEDIUM, re-check before any paper): evidence-gated state/process-aware inverse search with typed similarities and family-disjoint non-circular evaluation.

## N.20 Look-ahead / backward requirements

The full table is in `cards/G_I.md` §D. The five most critical:
1. **Step 04:** canonical support enum + RCL contract + fixed EXTERNAL_VERIFIED semantics.
2. **Step 08:** lineage ids + re-report edges for D6 and lineage-disjoint calibration.
3. **Step 09:** verifier labels + P(row correct) strata + dispersion/LOD/basis/imputation fields.
4. **Step 15:** a calibration partition and a frozen conflict table with trace.
5. **Steps 16–17:** calibrated slot extraction (the threat to structured retrieval).
